Mishneh Torah, Gifts to the Poor 7: Mitzvat ase litten tzedaka laaniyyim kefi ma sherauy leani. im hayta yad hannoten masseget. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 8)</small> "fatoach tiftach et yadcha lo" veneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 la)</small> "vehechezakta bo ger vetoshav vachay immach" veneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 36)</small> "veche achicha immach":
Vechol haroe ani mevakkesh veheelim enav mimmennu velo natan lo tzedaka avar belo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 7)</small> "lo teammetz et levavcha velo tikpotz et yadcha meachicha haevyon":

Lefi ma shechaser heani atta metzuvve litten lo. im en lo kesut mechassim oto. im en lo kele bayit konin lo. im en lo ishsha massiin oto. veim hayta ishsha massiin otah leish. afillu haya darko shel ze heani lirkov al hassus veeved ratz lefanav veheeni veyarad minnechasav konin lo sus lirkov alav veeved larutz lefanav shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 8)</small> "de machsoro asher yechsar lo". umetzuvve atta lehashelim chesrono veen atta metzuvve leashshero:
Yatom shebba lehassio ishsha. sochrin lo bayit umatztziim lo mitta vechol kele tashmisho veachar kach massiin lo ishsha:

Ba heani veshaal de machasoro veen yad hannoten masseget noten lo kefi hassagat yado vechamma ad chamishit nechasav mitzva min hammuvchar. veechad measara binchasav benoni. pachot mikkan ayin raa. uleolam lo yimna atzmo mishshelishit hashshekel beshana. vechol hannoten pachot mizze lo kiyyem mitzva. vaafillu ani hammitparnes min hatztzedaka chayyav litten tzedaka leacher:

Ani sheen makkirin oto veamar raev ani haachiluni en bodkin acharav shemma rammay hu ella mefarnesin oto miyyad. haya erom veamar kassuni bodkin acharav shemma rammay hu. veim hayu makkirin oto mechassin oto lefi kevodo miyyad veen bodkin acharav:

Mefarnesin umechassin aniyye akkum im aniyye yisrael mippene darche shalom. veani hamechazzer al happetachim en nizkakin lo lemattana merubba aval notnin lo mattana muetet. veasur lehachazir et heani sheshshaal rekam vaafillu atta noten lo gerogeret achat shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 74 21)</small> "al yashov dach nichlam":

En pochatin leani haover mimmakom lemakom mikkikkar echad hanimkar befunedyon keshehayu hachittim arba sein besela uchevar bearnu kol hammiddot. veim lan notnin lo matztza lishon alav vecheset litten tachat merashotav. veshemen vekitnit. veim shavat notnin lo mezon shalosh seuddot veshemen vekitnit vedag veyarak. veim hayu makkirin oto notnin lo lefi kevodo:
Ani sheeno rotze likkach tzedaka maarimin alav venotnin lo leshem mattana o leshem halevaa. veashir hammariv et atzmo veeno tzara bemamono shello yochal mimmennu velo yishte en mashgichin bo:

Mi sheeno rotze litten tzedaka o sheyyitten meat mimma sherauy lo. bet din kofin oto umakkin oto makkat mardut ad sheyyitten ma sheamaduhu litten. veyordin linchasav befanav velokchin mimmennu ma sherauy lo litten. umemashkenin al hatztzedaka vaafillu bearve shabbetot:

Adam shoa shehu noten tzedaka yoter min harauy lo. o shemmetzer leatzmo venoten laggabbaim kede shello yitbayyesh. asur letavo veligbot mimmennu tzedaka. vegabbay shemmachlimo veshoel mimmennu atid lehippara mimmennu shenneemar <small>(yirmeya 30 20)</small> "ufakadti al kol lochatzav":

En poskin tzedaka al yetomim vaafillu lefidyon shevuyim veaf al pi sheyyesh lahem mamon harebe. veim pasak haddayyan alehem kede lasum lahen shem muttar. gabbae tzedaka lokchin min hannashim umin haavadim umin hattinokot davar muat. aval lo davar merubbe. shechezkat hamerubbe geneva o gezel mishshel acherim. vechamma hu muat shellahen hakkol lefi osher habbealim vaaniyyutan:
Ani shehu kerovo kodem lechol adam. aniyye beto kodmin laaniyye iro. aniyye iro kodmin laaniyye ir acheret. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 11)</small> "leachicha laaniyyecha uleevyoncha beartzecha":

Mi shehalach bischora ufasku alav anshe hair shehalach sham tzedaka hare ze noten laaniyye otah hair. veim hayu rabbim ufasku alehen tzedaka notnin ucheshebbain meviin otah immahen umefarnesin bah aniyye iram. veim yesh sham chaver ir yittenuha lechaver ir vehu mechallekah kemo sheyyire lo:

Haomer tenu matayim dinar levet hakkeneset o tenu sefer tora levet hakkeneset yittenu levet hakkeneset shehu ragil bo. veim haya ragil bishnayim yittenu lishnehen. haomer tenu matayim dinarin laaniyyim yittenu laaniyye otah hair:
Mishneh Torah, Gifts to the Poor 8: Hatzedaka hare hi bichlal hannedarim. lefichach haomer hare alay sela litzdaka o hare sela zo tzedaka chayyav littenah laaniyyim miyyad veim icher avar b <small>(Devarim 23 22)</small> "val teacher" shehare beyado litten miyyad vaaniyyim metzuyin hen. en sham aniyyim mafrish umanniach ad sheyyimtza aniyyim. veim hitna shello yitten ad sheyyimtza ani eno tzarich lehaferish. vechen im hitna beshaa shennadar bitzdaka o hitnaddev oto sheyyihyu haggabbain rashshain leshannotah uletzarfah bezahav hare ellu muttarin:

Hammatpis bitzdaka chayyav kishar hannedarim. ketzad. amar hare sela zo kezo hare zo tzedaka. hammafrish sela veamar hare zo tzedaka velakach sela sheniyya veamar vezo hare sheniyya tzedaka. veaf al pi shello peresh:
Hannoder tzedaka velo yada kamma nadar yitten ad sheyyomar lo lechach nitkavvanti:

Echad haomer sela zo tzedaka o haomer hare alay sela litzdaka vehifrisho. im ratza leshannoto beacher muttar. veim mishshehiggia leyad haggabbay asur leshannoto. veim ratzu haggabbaim letzaref hammaot velaasotan dinarin enan rashshain ella im en sham aniyyim lechallek metzarfin laacherim. aval lo leatzman:
Haya laaniyyim hanaa beikkuv hammaot beyad haggabbay kede laasot laacherim litten. hare oto haggabbay muttar lilvot otam hammaot shel aniyyim uforea. shehatztzedaka enah kehekdesh sheasur lehanot bo:

Mi shehitnaddev menora o ner levet hakkeneset asur leshannotah. veim lidvar mitzva muttar leshannotah. af al pi shello nishtakka shem bealeha mealeha. ella omrim zo hammenora o ner shel peloni. veim nishtakka shem habbealim mealeha muttar leshannotah afillu lidvar harshut:

Bamme devarim amurim beshehaya hammitnaddev yisrael. aval im haya akkum asur leshannotah afillu lidvar mitzva ad sheyyishtakkea shem bealeha mealeha. shemma yomar haakkum hikdashti davar levet hakkeneset shel yehudim umecharuhu leatzman:

Akkum shehitnaddev levedek habbayit en mekabbelin mimmennu lechattechilla. veim lakchu mimmennu en machzirin lo. haya haddavar mesuyyam kegon kora o even machzirin lo kede shello yehe lahen davar mesuyyam bammikdash shenneemar <small>(Ezra 4 3)</small> "lo lachem valanu" vegomer. aval levet hakkeneset mekabbelin mehen lechattechilla. vehu sheyyomar kedaat yisrael hifrashti. veim lo amar taun geniza shemma libbo lashshamayim. veen mekabbelim mehem lechomat yerushalayim velo leammat hammayim shebbah shenneemar <small>(Nechemya 2 20)</small> "velachem en chelek vezikkaron birushalayim":

Asur leyisrael littol tzedaka min haakkum befarhesya. veim eno yachol lichyot bitzdaka shel yisrael veeno yachol littelah min haakkum betzina hare ze muttar. umelech o sar min haakkum sheshshalach mamon leyisrael litzdaka en machzirin oto lo mishshum shelom malchut. ella notlin mimmennu veyinnaten laaniyye akkum basseter kede shello yishma hammelech:

Pidyon shevuyim kodem lefarnasat aniyyim velichsutan. veen lecha mitzva gedola kefidyon shevuyim shehashshavuy hare hu bichlal harevim vehatztzemeim vaarummim veomed besakkanat nefashot. vehammaalim enav mippidyono hare ze over al <small>(Devarim 15 7)</small> "lo teammetz et levavcha velo tikpotz et yadcha" veal <small>(Vayikra 19 16)</small> "lo taamod al dam reecha" veal <small>(Vayikra 25 53)</small> "lo yirdennu beferech leenecha". uvittel mitzvat <small>(Devarim 15 8)</small> <small>(Devarim 15 11)</small> "fatoach tiftach et yadcha lo". umitzvat <small>(Vayikra 25 36)</small> "veche achicha immach". <small>(Vayikra 19 18)</small> "veahavta lereacha kamocha". <small>(Mishlei 24 11)</small> "vehatztzel lekuchim lammavet" veharebe devarim kaellu. veen lecha mitzva rabba kefidyon shevuyim:

Anshe hair sheggavu maot levinyan bet hakkeneset uva lahen devar mitzva motziin bo hammaot. kanu avanim vekorot lo yimkerum lidvar mitzva ella lefidyon shevuyim. af al pi sheheviu et haavanim ugedarum veet hakkorot ufesalum vehitkinu hakkol labbinyan mochrin hakkol lefidyon shevuyim bilvad. aval im banu vegamru lo yimkeru et bet hakkeneset ella yigbu lefidyonan min hatztzibbur:

En podin et hashshevuyim beyeter al demehen mippene tikkun haolam. shello yihyu haoyvim rodfin acharehem lishbotam. veen mavrichin et hashshevuyim mippene tikkun haolam shello yihyu haoyvim machbidin alehen et haol umarbim bishmiratan:

Mi shemmachar atzmo uvanav leakkum o shellava mehen veshavu otan o asaruhu behalevaatan. paam rishona usheniyya mitzva lifdotan. shelishit en podin otan. aval podin et habbanim leachar mitat avihen. veim bikkeshuhu lehargo podin oto miyyadam afillu achar kamma peamim:

Eved shennishba hoil vetaval leshem avdut vekibbel alav mitzvot podin oto keyisrael shennishba. veshavuy shehemir leakkum vaafillu lemitzva achat kegon shehaya ochel nevela lehacheis vechayyotze bo asur lifdoto:

Haishsha kodemet leish lehaachil velichsut ulehotzi mibbet hashshevi. mippene shehaish darko lechazzer lo haishsha uvashtah merubba. veim hayu shenehem bashshivya venitbeu shenehen lidvar avera haish kodem lifdot lefi sheen darko lechach:

Yatom vitoma shebbau lehassi otan massiin haishsha kodem laish mippene shebbashtah shel ishsha merubba. velo yifchatu lah mimmishkal shishsha dinarim urevia dinar shel kesef tahor. veim yesh bechis shel tzedaka notnin lah lefi kevodah:

Hayu lefanenu aniyyim harebe o shevuyim harebe veen bakkis kede lefarnes o kede lechassot o kede lifdot et kullan. makdimin et hakkohen lallevi. velevi leyisrael. veyisrael lechalal. vechalal lishtuki. ushetuki laasufi. vaasufi lemamzer. umamzer lenatin. venatin leger. shehannatin gadal immanu bikdushsha. veger kodem leeved meshuchrar. lefi shehaya bichlal arur:

Bamme devarim amurim beshehayu shenehen shavin bechachma. aval im haya kohen gadol am haaretz umamzer talmid chacham. talmid chacham kodem. vechol haggadol bechachma kodem et chavero. veim haya echad mehen rabbo o aviv af al pi sheyyesh sham gadol mehen bechachma. rabbo o aviv shehu talmid chacham kodem laze shehu gadol mehem bechachma:
Mishneh Torah, Gifts to the Poor 9:
Kol ir sheyyesh bah yisrael chayyavin lehaamid mehem gabbae tzedaka anashim yeduim veneemanim sheyyihyu machzirin al haam meerev shabbat leerev shabbat velokchin mikkol echad veechad ma shehu rauy litten vedavar hakkatzuv alav. vehen mechallekin hammaot meerev shabbat leerev shabbat venotnin lechol ani veani mezonot hammaspikin leshiva yamim. vezo hi hannikret kuppa: 
Vechen maamidin gabbain shellokchin bechol yom vayom mikkol chatzer vechatzer pat umine maachol o perot o maot mimmi shemmitnaddev lefi shaa. umechallekin et haggavuy laerev ben haaniyyim venotnin lechol ani mimmennu parnasat yomo. vezehu hannikra tamchuy: 
Meolam lo rainu velo shamanu bekahal miyyisrael sheen lahen kuppa shel tzedaka. aval tamchuy yesh mekomot shennahagu bo veyesh mekomot shello nahagu bo. vehamminhag happashut hayyom sheyyihyu gabbae hakkuppa machzirin bechol yom umechallekin meerev shabbat leerev shabbat: 
Betaaniyyot mechallekim mezonot laaniyyim. vechol taanit sheachlu haam velanu velo chilleku tzedaka laaniyyim hare ellu keshofche damim vaalehem neemar bakkabbala <small>(yeshaya 1 21)</small> "tzedek yalin bah veatta meratztzechim". bamme devarim amurim beshello natnu lahen happat vehapperot sheochlim bahem happat kegon temarim vaanavim. aval im echaru hammaot o hachittim enan keshofche damim: 
Hakkuppa enah nigbet ella bishnayim sheen osim serara al hatztzibbur bemamon pachot mishshenayim. umuttar lehaamin leechad hammaot shel kuppa. veenah nechleket ella bishlosha mippene shehi kedine mamonot. shennotnim lechol echad de machasoro leshabbat. vhattamchuy nigbe bishlosha sheeno davar katzuv. umitchallek bishlosha: 
Hattamchuy nigbe bechol yom. vehakkuppa meerev shabbat leerev shabbat. vehattamchuy laaniyye olam. vehakkuppa laaniyye otah hair bilvad: 
Rashshain bene hair laasot kuppa tamchuy. vetamchuy kuppa. uleshannotan lechol ma sheyyirtzu mitztzarche tzibbur. veaf al pi shello hitnu ken beshaa sheggavu. veim haya bammedina chacham gadol shehakkol govin al dato vehu yechallek laaniyyim kefi ma sheyyire. hare ze rashshay leshannotan lechol ma sheyyerae lo mitztzarche tzibbur: 
Gabbae tzedaka en rashshain lifrosh ze mizze bashshuk. ella kede sheyyihye ze poresh lashshaar veze poresh lachanut vegovin: 
Matza haggabbay maot bashshuk lo yittenem letoch kiso ella letoch arneki shel tzedaka. uchesheyyaggia leveto yitlem: 
Haya haggabbay noshe bachavero mane uferao bashshuk lo yittenem letoch kiso ella letoch arneki shel tzedaka. uchesheyyaggia leveto yitlem. velo yimne maot hakkuppa shenayim shenayim ella echad echad mippene hachashad shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 32 22)</small> "vihyitem nekiyyim meAdonai umiyyisrael": 
Gabbae tzedaka sheen lahem aniyyim lechallek metzarfin hammaot dinarin laacherim aval lo leatzman. gabbae tamchuy sheen lahem aniyyim lechallek mochrim laacherim veen mochrim leatzmam. veen mechashshevim bitzdaka im gabbae tzedaka. velo bahekdesh im haggizbarin. shenneemar <small>(Melachim 2 22 7)</small> "ach lo yechashev ittam hakkesef hannittan al yadam ki beemuna hem osim": 
Mi sheyyashav bammedina sheloshim yom kofin oto litten tzedaka lakkuppa im bene hammedina. yashav sham shelosha chodashim kofin oto litten hattamchuy. yashav sham shishsha chodashim kofin oto litten tzedaka bichsut shemmechassim bah aniyye hair. yashav sham tisha chodashim kofin oto litten tzedaka likvura shekkovrin bah et haaniyyim veosin lahem kol tzarche kevura: 
Mi sheyyesh lo mezon shete seuddot asur lo littol min hattamchuy. hayu lo mezon arba esre seuddot lo yittol min hakkuppa. hayu lo matayim zuz af al pi sheeno nose venoten bahem [o sheyyesh lo chamishshim zuz venose venoten bahem] hare ze lo yittol leket shichcha ufea umaaser ani. hayu lo matayim chaser dinar afillu elef notnin lo keechad hare ze muttar likkach. hayu beyado maot vahare hen alav chov o shehayu memushkanim lichtubbat ishto hare ze muttar likkach: 
Ani shetztzarich veyesh lo chatzer uchele bayit afillu hayu lo kele kesef uchele zahav en mechayyevin oto limkor et beto veet kele tashmisho ella muttar likkach. umitzva litten lo. bamme devarim amurim bichle achila ushetiyya umalbush umatztzaot vechayyotze bahen. aval im hayu kele kesef uchele zahav kegon migredet o eli vechayyotze bahen mochran velokeach pachot mehen. bamme devarim amurim kodem sheyyaggia ligbot min haam. aval achar sheggava hatztzedaka mechayyevim oto limkor kelav velikkach acherim pechutin mehem veachar kach yittol: 
Baal habbayit shehaya mehallech lair vetammu lo hammaot badderech veen lo atta ma yochal hare ze muttar likkach leket shichcha ufea umaasar ani velehanot min hatztzedaka. velichsheyyaggia leveto eno chayyav leshallem shehare ani haya beotah shaa. ha lema ze dome leani sheheeshir sheeno chayyav leshallem: 
Mi shehayu lo battim sadot ucheramim veim mochran bime haggeshamim mochran bezol veim hinnichan ad yemot hachamma mochran beshoyehen. en mechayyevin oto limkor ella maachilin oto maasar ani ad chatzi demehen velo yidchok atzmo veyimkor shello bizman mechira: 
Hayu shear haadam lokchin beyoker vehu eno motze sheyyikkach mimmennu ella bezol mippene shehu dachuk vetarud en mechayyevin oto limkor. ella ochel maasar ani veholech ad sheyyimkor beshave veyedu hakkol sheeno dachuk limkor: 
Ani sheggavu lo kede lehashelim machasoro vehotiru al ma shehu tzarich hare hammotar shello. umotar aniyyim laaniyyim. umotar shevuyim lashshevuyim. motar shavuy leoto shavuy. motar metim lammetim. motar hammet leyorshav: 
Ani shennatan peruta lattamchuy o peruta lakkuppa mekabbelim mimmennu. veim lo natan en mechayyevin oto litten. natnu lo begadim chadashim vehechezir lahen et hashshechakin mekabbelin mimmennu. veim lo natan en mechayyevin oto litten:
Mishneh Torah, Gifts to the Poor 10:
Chayyavin anu lehizzaher bemitzvat tzedaka yoter mikkol mitzvot ase. shehatztzedaka siman latztzaddik zera avraham avinu shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 18 19)</small> "ki yedativ lemaan asher yetzavve et banav" <small>(Bereshit 18 19)</small> "laasot tzedaka". veen kisse yisrael mitkonen vedat haemet omedet ella bitzdaka shenneemar <small>(yeshaya ned yad)</small> "bitzdaka tikkonani". veen yisrael nigalin ella bitzdaka shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 1 27)</small> "tziyyon bemishpat tippade veshaveha bitzdaka": 
Leolam en adam maani min hatztzedaka veen davar ra velo hezzek niglal bishvil hatztzedaka shenneemar <small>(yeshaya lev 17)</small> "vehaya maase hatztzedaka shalom." kol hamerachem merachamin alav shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 18)</small> "venatan lecha rachamim verichamcha vehirbecha". vechol mi shehu achzari veeno merachem yesh lachush leyachaso. sheen haachzariyyut metzuya ella beakkum shenneemar <small>(yirmeya 50 42)</small> "achzari hemma velo yerachemu". vechol yisrael vehannilve alehem keachim hem shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 1)</small> "banim attem laAdonai elohechem" veim lo yerachem haach al haach mi yerachem alav. ulemi aniyye yisrael nosin enehen. halakkum shessonin otan verodfim acharehen. ha en enehen teluyot ella laachehen: 
Kol hammaalim enav min hatztzedaka hare ze nikra beliyyaal kemo shennikra oved akkum beliyyaal. uveakkum hu omer <small>(Devarim 13 14)</small> "yatzu anashim bene veliyyaal" uvemaalim enav min hatztzedaka hu omer <small>(Devarim 15 9)</small> "hishshamer lecha pen yihye davar im levavcha veliyyaal". venikra rasha shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 12 10)</small> "verachame reshaim achzari". venikra chote shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 9)</small> "vekara alecha el Adonai vehaya vecha chet". vehakkadosh baruch hu karov leshavat aniyyim shenneemar shavat aniyyim atta tishma. lefichach tzarich lehizzaher betzaakatam shehare berit keruta lahem shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 26)</small> "vehaya ki yitzak elay veshamati ki channun ani": 
Kol hannoten tzedaka leani besever panim raot ufanav kevushot bakkarka afillu natan lo elef zehuvim ibbed zechuto vehifsidah. ella noten lo besever panim yafot uvesimcha umitonen immo al tzarato shenneemar <small>(Iyov 30 25)</small> "im lo vachiti likshe yom agma nafshi laevyon". umedabber lo divre tachanunim venichumim shenneemar <small>(Iyov 29 13)</small> "velev almana arnin": 
Shaal heani mimmecha veen beyadcha kelum litten lo payyesehu bidvarim. veasur ligor beani o lehagebiah kolo alav bitzaka. mippene shellibbo nishbar venidke vahare hu omer <small>(Tehillim 51 19)</small> "lev nishbar venidke elohim lo tivze". veomer <small>(yeshaya 57 15)</small> "lehachayot ruach shefalim ulehachayot lev nidkaim". veoy lemi shehichlim et heani oy lo. ella yihye lo keav ben berachamim ben bidvarim shenneemar <small>(Iyov 29 16)</small> "av anochi laevyonim": 
Hakkofe acherim litten tzedaka umeasse otan secharo gadol missechar hannoten shenneemar <small>(yeshaya lev 17)</small> "vehaya maase hatztzedaka shalom". veal gabbae tzedaka vechayyotze bahem omer <small>(Daniel 12 3)</small> "umatzdike harabbim kakkochavim": 
Shemone maalot yesh batztzedaka zo lemala mizzo. maala gedola sheen lemala mimmenna ze hammachazik beyad yisrael shemmach venoten lo mattana o halevaa o ose immo shuttafut o mamtzi lo melacha kede lechazzek et yado ad shello yitztarech labberiyyot lishl. veal ze neemar <small>(Vayikra 25 la)</small> "vehechezakta bo ger vetoshav vachay immach" kelomar hachazek bo ad shello yippol veyitztarech: 
Pachot mizze hannoten tzedaka laaniyyim velo yada lemi natan velo yada heani mimmi lakach. shehare zo mitzva lishmah. kegon lishkat chashaim shehayta bammikdash. shehayu hatztzaddikim notnin bah bachashay vehaaniyyim bene tovim mitparnesin mimmenna bachashay. vekarov laze hannoten letoch kuppa shel tzedaka. velo yitten adam letoch kuppa shel tzedaka ella im ken yodea shehamemunne neeman vechacham veyodea lehanehig kashshura kerabbi chananya ben teradyon: 
Pachot mizze sheyyeda hannoten lemi yitten velo yeda heani mimmi lakach. kegon gedole hachachamim shehayu holchin basseter umashlichin hammaot befitche haaniyyim. vechaze rauy laasot umaala tova hi im en hamemunnin bitzdaka nohagin kashshura: 
Pachot mizze sheyyeda heani mimmi natal velo yeda hannoten. kegon gedole hachachamim shehayu tzorrim hammaot bisdinehen umafshilin laachorehen uvain haaniyyim venotlin kede shello yihye lahen busha: 
Pachot mizze sheyyitten lo beyado kodem sheyyishal: 
Pachot mizze sheyyitten lo achar sheyyishal: 
Pachot mizze sheyyitten lo pachot min harauy besever panim yafot: 
Pachot mizze sheyyitten lo beetzev: 
Gedole hachachamim hayu notnin peruta leani kodem kol tefilla veachar kach mitpallelin shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 17 15)</small> "ani betzedek echeze fanecha": 
Hannoten mezonot levanav velivnotav haggedolim sheeno chayyav bimzonotehen kede lelammed hazzecharim tora ulehanhig habbanot bederech yeshara velo yihyu mevuzzot. vechen hannoten mezonot leaviv uleimmo hare ze bichlal hatztzedaka. utzedaka gedola hi shehakkarov kodem. vechol hammaachil umashke aniyyim vitomim al shulchano hare ze kore el Adonai veyaanehu umitanneg shenneemar <small>(yeshaya noach 9)</small> "az tikra vaAdonai yaane": 
Tziuu chachamim sheyyihyu bene beto shel adam aniyyim vitomim bimkom haavadim. mutav lo lehishtammesh beellu veyehanu bene avraham yitzchak veyaakov minnechasav velo yehanu bahem zera cham. shekkol hammarbe avadim bechol yom vayom mosif chet veavon baolam. veim yihyu aniyyim bene beto bechol shaa veshaa mosif zechuyyot umitzvot: 
Leolam yidchok adam atzmo veyitgalgel betzaar veal yitztarech labberiyyot veal yashlich atzmo al hatztzibbur. vechen tziuu chachamim veamru ase shabbattecha chol veal titztarech labberiyyot. vaafillu haya chacham umechubbad veheeni yaasok beummenut vaafillu beummenut menuvvelet velo yitztarech labberiyyot. mutav lifshot or behemot nevelot velo yomar laam chacham gadol ani kohen ani parnesuni. uvechach tziuu chachamim. gedole hachachamim hayu mehem chotve etzim venose hakkorot veshoave mayim lagginnot veose habbarzel vehappechamim velo shaalu min hatztzibbur velo kibbelu mehem keshennatnu lahem: 
Kol mi sheeno tzarich littol umeramme et haam venotel eno met min hazzikna ad sheyyitztarech labberiyyot. vahare hu bichlal <small>(yirmeya 17 5)</small> "arur haggever asher yivtach baadam". vechol mi shetztzarich littol veeno yachol lichyot ella im ken notel kegon zaken o chole o baal yissurin umegis dato veeno notel hare ze shofech damim umitchayyev benafsho veen lo betzaaro ella chattaot vaashamot. vechol mi shetztzarich littol vetzier vedachak et hashshaa vechaya chayye tzaar kede shello yatriach al hatztzibbur eno met min hazzikna ad sheyyefarnes acherim mishshello. vealav veal kol kayyotze baze neemar <small>(yirmeya 17 7)</small> "baruch haggever asher yivtach baAdonai": seliku lehu hilchot mattenot aniyyim besiyata dishmayya
Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 1: Hatterumot vehammaasrot enan nohagin min hattora ella beeretz yisrael. ben bifne habbayit ben shello bifne habbayit. uneviim hitkinu sheyyehu nohagot afillu beeretz shinar mippene shehi semucha leeretz yisrael verov yisrael holchin veshavin sham. vehachachamim harishonim hitkinu sheyyihyu nohagot af beeretz mitzrayim uveeretz ammon umoav mippene shehem sevivot leeretz yisrael:

Eretz yisrael haamura bechol makom hi baaratzot shekkibbeshan melech yisrael o navi middaat rov yisrael vezehu hannikra kibbush rabbim. aval yachid miyyisrael o mishpacha o shevet shehalchu vechavshu leatzman makom afillu min haaretz shennittena leavraham eno nikra eretz yisrael kede sheyyinhagu bo kol hammitzvot. umippene ze chillek yehoshua uvet dino kol eretz yisrael lishvatim af al pi shello nichbesha kede shello yihye kibbush yachid kesheyyaale kol shevet veshevet veyichbosh chelko:

Haaratzot shekkavash david chutz leeretz kenaan kegon aram naharayim vaaram tzova veachlav vechayyotze bahen af al pi shemmelech yisrael hu veal pi bet din haggadol hu ose eno keeretz yisrael lechol davar velo kechutza laaretz lechol davar kegon bavel umitzrayim. ella yatzu mikkelal chutza laaretz velihyotan keeretz yisrael lo higgiu. umippene ma yardu mimmaalat eretz yisrael mippene shekkavash otam kodem sheyyichbosh kol eretz yisrael ella nishar bah mishshiva amamim. veillu tafas kol eretz kenaan ligvuloteha veachar kach kavash aratzot acherot haya kibbusho kullo keeretz yisrael lechol davar. vehaaratzot shekkavash david hen hannikrain sureya:

Sureya yesh devarim shehi bahen keeretz yisrael veyesh devarim shehi bahen kechutza laaretz. vehakkone bah karka kekone beeretz yisrael leinyan terumot umaasrot usheviit. vehakkol besureya middivre sofrim:

Kol shehecheziku ole mitzrayim venitkaddesh kedushsha rishona kevan sheggalu batla kedushshatan. shekkedushsha rishona lefi shehayta mippene hakkibbush bilvad kadsha lishatah velo kadsha leatid lavo. kevan shealu bene haggola vehecheziku bemiktzat haaretz kiddeshuha kedushsha sheniyya haomedet leolam lishatah veleatid lavo. vehinnichu otam hammekomot shehecheziku bahem ole mitzrayim velo hecheziku bahem ole bavel keshehayu velo petarum min hatteruma vehammaasrot kede sheyyismechu alehem aniyyim bishviit. verabbenu hakkadosh hittir bet shean meotam hammekomot shello hecheziku bahem ole bavel. vehu nimna al ashkelon ufetarah min hammaasrot:

Nimtza kol haolam leinyan mitzvot hatteluyot baaretz nechleket leshalosh machalokot. eretz yisrael. vesureya. vechutza laaretz. veeretz yisrael nechleket lishnayim. kol shehecheziku ole bavel chelek echad. vechol shehecheziku ole mitzrayim bilvad chelek sheni. vechutza laaretz nechleket lishnayim. eretz mitzrayim veshinar veammon umoav hammitzvot nohagot bahem middivre sofrim uneviim. ushear haaratzot en terumot umaasrot nohagot bahen:

E zo hi eretz shehecheziku bah ole mitzrayim. merekem shehu bemizrach eretz yisrael ad hayyam haggadol. meashkelon shehi lidrom eretz yisrael ad akko shehi batztzafon. haya mehallech meakko lichziv kol haaretz sheal yemino shehu mizrach hadderech hare hi bechezkat chutza laaretz utemea mishshum eretz haammim ufetura min hammaaser umin hashsheviit. ad sheyyivvada lecha sheoto hammakom meeretz yisrael. vechol haaretz sheal semolo shehu maarav hadderech hare hi bechezkat eretz yisrael utehora mishshum eretz haammim vechayyevet bemaaser uvishviit. ad sheyyivvada lecha sheoto makom chutza laaretz. vechol sheshshofea veyored mitture amanom velifnim eretz yisrael. mitture amanom velachutz chutza laaretz. vehanissim shebbayyam roin otan keillu chut matuach alehem mitture amanom vead nachal mitzrayim. min hachut velifnim eretz yisrael. min hachut velachutz chutza laaretz. vezo hi tzuratah:
Mehechan hecheziku ole bavel. mikkeziv velifnim keneged hammizrach. umikkeziv velachutz ad amana vehi amanom vead hannahar vehu nachal mitzrayim lo hecheziku bo. ucheziv atzmah lo hecheziku bah:

E zo hi sureya. meeretz yisrael ulematta keneged aram naharayim vaaram tzova kol yad perat ad bavel kegon dammesek veachlav vecharan umiggevat vechayyotze bahen ad shinar vetzohar hare hi kesureya. aval akko chutza laaretz keashkelon vehem techume eretz yisrael:

Akkum shekkana karka beeretz yisrael lo hifkiuha min hammitzvot ella hare hi bikdushshatah. lefichach im chazar yisrael ulekachah mimmennu enah kechibbush yachid ella mafrish terumot umaasrot umevi bikkurim. vehakkol min hattora keillu lo nimkera leakkum meolam veyesh kinyan leakkum besureya lehafekia min hammaasrot umin hashsheviit kemo sheyyitbaer:

Perot haakkum sheggadlu bekarka shekkana beeretz yisrael. im nigmera melachtam beyad akkum umerchan haakkum peturin mikkelum shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 4)</small> "degancha" velo degan akkum. veim lekachan yisrael achar shennitleshu kodem shettiggamer melachtan ugemaran yisrael chayyavin bakkol min hattora. umafrish teruma gedola venotnah lakkohen. uterumat maaser umochrah lakkohen. umaaser rishon hi shello mippene shehu omer lallevi bemaaser velakkohen bitrumat maaser ani bati mikkoach ish sheen attem yecholin littol mimmennu kelum. umippene ma amru lo yitten terumat maaser lakkohen kitruma gedola. lefi shenneemar bitrumat maaser <small>(Bamidbar 18 26)</small> "ki tikchu meet bene yisrael et hammaaser" tevel sheatta lokeach miyyisrael atta mafrish mimmennu terumat maaser venotnah lakkohen. aval tevel sheatta lokeach min haakkum en atta noten lakkohen hatterumat maaser shehifrish mimmennu ella mochrah lakkohen velokeach dameha:

Machar haakkum happerot shello leyisrael keshehen mechubbarin bakkarka. im ad shello ba leonat hammaasrot venigmeru beyad yisrael chayyavin bakkol venoten hatterumot vehammaasrot labbealim. veim mecharan achar shebbau leonat hammaasrot mafrish terumat maaser umaaser venoten mehen labbealim lefi cheshbon. ketzad. lakach tevua zerua min haakkum achar shehevia shelish venigmera beyad yisrael. mafrish terumot umaasrot kemo shebbearnu venoten shene shelishe hammaaser lallevi ushene shelishe terumat maaser lakkohen umocher lo hashshelish:

Yisrael shemmachar perotav leakkum kodem sheyyavou leonat hammaasrot ugemaran haakkum peturin min hatteruma umin hammaasrot. veim achar shebbau leonat hammaasrot af al pi sheggemaran haakkum chayyav bakkol middivrehem. vechen haakkum sheggamar perot yisrael. hoil vediggunan beyad akkum enan chayyavin bitruma umaasrot ella middivrehen:

Machar akkum leyisrael perot mechubbarin achar shebbau leonat hammaasrot umerchan haakkum birshut yisrael enan chayyavin bitruma umaasrot. hoil uvau leonat hammaasrot birshut akkum umerchan haakkum af al pi shehen birshut yisrael:

Hakkone sade besureya chayyav bitrumot umaasrot middivrehem kemo sheyyitchayyev min hattora hakkone birushalayim kemo shebbearnu. aval hakkone perot min haakkum besureya ben telushin ben mechubbarim afillu kodem shebbau leonat hammaasrot af al pi shemerchan yisrael hoil veeno mikkarka shello patur:
Kana karka min haakkum besureya uferot mechubbarin bah im higgiu leonat hammaasrot beyad haakkum peturin. veim adayin lo higgiu leonat hammaasrot hoil vekana otam im hakkarka chayyav leasser:

Yisrael shehaya aris leakkum besureya perotav peturin min hammaasrot lefi sheen lo beguf hakkarka kelum. veyesh leakkum kinyan besureya lehafekia min hammaasrot kemo shebbearnu. vechen hachocher vehamekabbel vehassocher sade min haakkum besureya patur min hatterumot umin hammaasrot:

Yisrael shellakach besureya sade min haakkum ad shello hevia shelish vechazar umecharah leakkum meachar shehevia shelish im chazar yisrael ulekachah paam sheniyya hare ze chayyav bitrumot umaasrot shehare nitchayyeva beyad yisrael:
Yisrael shehaya lo karka besureya vehorid lah aris veshalach lo haaris perot hare ellu peturim sheani omer min hashshuk lekachan. vehu sheyyihye oto hammin matzuy bashshuk:

Shuttafut haakkum chayyevet bitrumot umaasrot ketzad. yisrael veakkum shellakchu sade beshuttafut afillu chilleku sade bekamatah veen tzarich lomar im chilleku gadish hare tevel vechullin meoravin bechol kelach vekelach mechelko shel akkum af al pi shemerchan haakkum vechiyyuvam middivrehem kemo shebbearnu:

Bamme devarim amurim beeretz yisrael shehammaasrot shel tora uveshel tora en berera aval im lakchu sade besureya hoil vehammaasrot sham middivrehem afillu chilleku haggadish chelko shel akkum patur mikkelum:

Perot eretz yisrael sheyyatzu chutza laaretz peturin min hachalla umin hatterumot umin hammaasrot shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 18)</small> "asher ani mevi etchem shamma". shamma attem chayyavin bechutza laaretz peturin. veim yatzu lesureya chayyavin middivrehem. vechen perot chutza laaretz shennichnesu laaretz chayyavin bechalla shenneemar shamma. shamma attem chayyavin ben beferot haaretz ben beferot chutza laaretz. veim nikbeu lemaaser beyad yisrael achar shennichnesu laaretz chayyavin bemaasrot middivrehem:
Afar chutza laaretz shebba bisfina laaretz. bizman shehassefina gosheshet laaretz hare hatztzomeach bo chayyav bitruma umaasrot usheviit katztzomeach beeretz yisrael atzmah:

Ilan sheomed bechutza laaretz venofo note laaretz. o omed baaretz venofo note lechutza laaretz. hakkol holech achar haikkar. hayu miktzat sharashav baaretz umiktzatan chutza laaretz afillu haya tzechiach sela mavdil benehen hare tevel vechullin meoravin ze baze:
Atzitz nakuv shehaya bo zera shello hishrish vehaya ikkaro baaretz venofo chutza laaretz holchim achar hannof:

Hatteruma bazzeman hazze vaafillu bemakom shehecheziku ole bavel vaafillu bime ezra enah min hattora ella middivrehen. sheen lecha teruma shel tora ella beeretz yisrael bilvad uvizman shekkol yisrael sham shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 2)</small> "ki tavou" biat kullechem keshehayu birushsha rishona uchemo shehen atidin lachazor birushsha shelishit. lo keshehayu birushsha sheniyya shehayta bime ezra shehayta biat miktzatan ulefichach lo chiyyeva otan min hattora. vechen yerae li shehu haddin bemaasrot sheen chayyavin bazzeman hazze ella middivrehem kitruma:
Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 2: Kol ochel adam hannishmar sheggiddulav min haaretz chayyav bitruma. umitzvat ase lehaferish mimmennu reshit lakkohen shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 4)</small> "reshit degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha" <small>(Devarim 18 4)</small> "titten lo". ma dagan tirosh veyitzhar maachal bene adam vegiddulav min haaretz veyesh lo bealim shenneemar degancha af kol kayyotze bahen chayyav bitrumot vechen bemaasrot:

Hakkarshinin af al pi sheenam maachal adam hoil veochlin otan bishne reavon chayyavin bitruma umaasrot. hassia vehaezov vehakkoranit shezzeraan mittechilla leadam chayyavin bemaaser. vechen kol kayyotze bahen. zeraan lemaachal behema af al pi shennimlach vechishshev alehen leadam keshehen mechubbarin peturin shemmachshevet chibbur enah kelum. alu mealehen bechatzer. im hi chatzer hameshammeret peroteha hare ellu chayyavin shessetaman leadam veim enah meshammeret peroteha petura:

Zerone ginna sheenan neechalim kegon zera lefet vezera tzenon vezera betzalim vechayyotze bahen peturim min hatteruma umin hammaasrot mippene sheenan ochel adam. aval hakketzach chayyav bitruma uvemaasrot:

Temarot shel tiltan veshel chardal veshel pol hallavan veshel tzalaf vehakkafrisin shel tzalaf peturim mippene sheenan peri. bamme devarim amurim beshezzeraan lezera. aval zeraan leyarak hare ellu chayyavim. vechen haevyonot shel tzalaf chayyavim mippene shehen peri:

Kusbar shezzeraah lezera yarkah patur min hatteruma umin hammaasrot. zeraah leyarak mafrish terumot umaasrot min hayerakot umin hazzera. vechen hashshevet shezzeraah lezera yarkah patur. zeraah leyarak mitasseret zera veyarak. veenah mitasseret zirin. zeraah lezirin mafrish teruma umaasrot min hazzera umin hayyarak umin hazzirin. vechen hashshichalayim vehaggarger shezzeraan lezera mitasserin zera veyarak. ketzad mitasserin lezera uleyarak. sheim likket hayyarak leachlo mafrish teruma umaasrot veachar kach yochal. uchesheyyivash veyeesof hazzera shello mafrish min hazzera:

Hayerakot af al pi shehen maachal adam enan chayyavin bemaasrot ella middivrehen. lefi shenneemar bemaaser <small>(Devarim 14 22)</small> "tevuat zarecha". tevua vechayyotze bah. aval hayerakot enan bichlal hattevua. vechen yerae li shehu haddin bitruma. shehare neemar bah <small>(Devarim 18 4)</small> "degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha" kol haddome leellu aval terumat hayyarak middivrehem kemaaser:

En mafrishin terumot umaasrot min hayyarak bechutza laaretz. vaafillu bimkomot sheamarnu shemmafrishin bahen maasrot. vechen yarak habba michutza laaretz laaretz af al pi sheyyesh afar beikkareha hare ze patur velo gazru alav. hattevua vehakkitnit shezzeraan leyarak batla dato etzel kol adam. vehayyarak shellahen patur. vehazzera chayyav bitruma umaasrot:
Hattiltan af al pi sheeno ochel adam kesheyyikshu hoil verov haadam ochlin otan bitchillatan hare hen chayyavin bitruma umaaser:

Veellu peturin min hatteruma umin hammaasrot. halleket vehashshichcha vehappea vehapperet vehaolelot. afillu heemid mehen keri. veim asa mehen goren bassade hukbeu lemaasrot umafrish mehen teruma umaasrot. aval im asa haggoren bair peturin. shehare kol yesh lahen shehakkol yodin shehen leket o shichcha o pea:

Halleket vehashshichcha vehappea shel akkum chayyavin bitruma umaasrot. ella im ken hifkir. vechen hattevua vehazzetim shello heviu shelish peturin min hatteruma umin hammaasrot. uminnayin yodea. kol shezzorah umatzmachat beyadua shehevia shelish. avar vehifrish mittevua vezetim shello heviu shelish enah teruma:
Vechen hahefker patur min hatteruma umin hammaasrot. vaafillu hifkiro haakkum lo. aval hazzorea sede hefker chayyav bitruma umaasrot:

Hifkir kama vezacha bah veavar vehifrish mimmenna teruma hare zo teruma. aval im hifkir shibbolim vezacha bahen veavar vehifrish mehen teruma enah teruma. vechen kol hammafrish middavar sheeno chayyav teruma enah teruma. vechen bemaasrot. devarim sheen derech rov bene adam lezaran bagginnot uvassadot ella chezkatan min hahefker peturin min hatteruma umin hammaasrot. kegon hashshum baal bechi. uvatzal shel richpa. ugeris hakkilkeli. vaadashim hammitzriyyot vechayyotze bahen:

Nitarev davar shechayyav bitruma bedavar sheeno chayyav. kegon zete nikkuf shennitarvu bezete masik veinve olelot beinve batzir. im yesh lo perot acherot motzi al hachayyav lefi cheshbon. veim en lo ella ellu mafrish teruma uterumat maaser al hakkol ucheillu hakkol chayyav bitruma. umafrish maaser rishon vesheni lefi cheshbon davar hachayyav:

Hatteruma lakkohen ben tehora ben temea afillu nitma haddagan o hattirosh kullo kodem sheyyafrish hare ze chayyav lehaferish mimmennu teruma betuma velittenah lakkohen shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 8)</small> "vaani natatti lecha et mishmeret terumotay", achat tehora veachat temea. hattehora neechelet lakkohanim vehattemea yehanu bisrefatah. im haya shemen madlikin oto. veim haya dagan vechayyotze bo massikin bo et hattannur:
Vechen terumat maaser im nitmet o nitma hammaaser mafrishin otah betuma venittenet lakkohen lehanot bisrefatah:
Vechol hammafrish teruma gedola o terumat maaser mevarech kodem sheyyafrish kederech shemmevarchin al kol hammitzvot kemo shebbearnu bivrachot:

En motziin teruma mehaaretz lechutza laaretz afillu temea. veen meviin teruma michutza laaretz laaretz. veim hevi lo teachel mippene shehi temea beeretz hakkutim. velo tissaref shello yomru rainu teruma shello nitmet nisrefet. velo tachazor lechutza laaretz shemma yomru motziin teruma lechutza laaretz. ella mannichin otah ad shettittame tuma yedua lakkol o ad sheyyavo erev happesach im hayta chametz vetissaref:
Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 3: Teruma gedola en lah shiur min hattora. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 4)</small> "reshit degancha" kol shehu afillu chitta achat poteret hakkeri. ulechattechilla lo yafrish ella kashshiur shennatnu chachamim. uvazzeman hazze shehi omedet lisrefa mippene hattuma yesh lo lehaferish kol shehu lechattechilla:
Vechamma hu shiurah shennatnu chachamim. ayin yafa echad mearbaim. vehabbenonit echad mechamishshim. raa echad mishshishshim. velo yifchot meechad mishshishshim:

Kol teruma sheen hakkohanim makpidin aleha kegon terumot hecharuvin vehakkelisin nittelet lechattechilla echad mishshishshim. veellu nittalin echad mishshishshim. terumat giddule teruma veeruve teruma uteruma temea shehayta hattuma beones o bishgaga uterumat hekdesh uterumat chutza laaretz uterumat hakketzach vehakkelisin vehecharuvin vehaggimziyyot vehatturmosin useorim adomiyyot vechayyotze bahen uferot atzitz sheeno nakuv. vechen haappotroppesin keshettormin perot yetomim tormin echad mishshishshim:

En tormin teruma zo lo bemidda velo bemishkal velo beminyan lefi shello neemar bah shiur ella omed umafrish bedato kemo echad (mishshishshim) [mechamishshim]. aval torem hu et hammadud veet hashshakul veet hammanuy. velo yitrom besal uvekuppa shemmiddatan yedua. aval torem hu bahen chetzyan o shelishan. velo yitrom bisa chetzyah shehachetzyah midda:

Hammarbe bitruma hoil veshiyyer miktzat chullin hare zo teruma. aval im amar kol happerot haellu teruma lo amar kelum. hammitkavven litrom echad measara vealta beyado echad mishshishshim terumato teruma. nitkavven litrom echad mishshishshim vealta beyado echad mechamishshim eno teruma:

Hammafrish teruma vealta beyado afillu echad meesrim terumato teruma. taram vealta beyado echad mishshishshim vechazar vehosif leshem teruma otah hattosefet chayyevet bemaasrot umafrish mimmenna hakkohen hammaasrot veachar kach yochlenna. taram vealta beyado echad mishshishshim veechad hare zo teruma veyachazor veyitrom paam sheniyya kede lehashelim hashshiur shebbedato. vehattosefet hazzot yesh lo lehaferishah bemidda o bemishkal o beminyan aval lo yafrishenna ella min hammukkaf karishona:
Hammafrish miktzat hatteruma oto hammiktzat eno teruma vahare hu kecholek hakkeri. veaf al pi chen tzarich lehaferish terumat oto miktzat mimmennu. velo yafrish alav mipperot acherot:

Hammafrish miktzat teruma mikkeri ze umiktzat teruma mikkeri acher mimmino. hare ze lo yitrom mizze al ze. homer terumat hakkeri ze letocho im amar bitzfono o bidromo kara shem vechayyav lehaferish mimmennu terumato veim lo tziyyen bemakom lo amar kelum:
Amar terumat hakkeri ze vehakkeri hazze kaze makom shennistayyema terumato shel rishon sham nistayyema terumato shel sheni:
Terumat maaser en mafrishin otah beomed. ella medakdek beshiurah vaafillu bazzeman hazze. shehare shiurah meforash battora:

Davar sheddarko limdod moded. vedavar hannishkal shokel. davar sheefshar limnoto mone. haya efshar limnoto uleshaklo ulemaddo hammone meshubbach vehammoded meshubbach mimmennu vehashshokel meshubbach mishshenehen:

Mitzvat terumat maaser sheyyafrish otan ben levi mimmaasro. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 26)</small> "vechi tikchu meet bene yisrael et hammaaser". veyesh leyisrael lehaferish otah velittenah lakkohen. veyitten hammaaser lallevi achar sheyyafrish mimmennu terumato shehi maaser min hammaaser:

Yisrael shehifrish maaser rishon keshehu shibbolim kodem sheyyadush veyafrish teruma gedola unetano lelevi. en hallevi chayyav lehaferish mimmennu teruma gedola achar sheyyedushennu ella terumat maaser bilvad. aval im dash yisrael vehifrish hammaaser min haddagan kodem sheyyafrish teruma gedola [unetano lelevi chayyav hallevi lehaferish mimmennu teruma gedola] uterumat maaser meachar shennaasa dagan nitchayyev bitruma shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 4)</small> "reshit degancha":

Ben levi shellakach maasar shibbolim lo yitten terumato lakkohen shibbolim ella konsin oto ladush velizrot velitten lo maaser min hammaaser min haddagan. veeno chayyav litten lo maaser min hatteven o haetza. veim hifrish terumat maaser shibbolim kemo shennatnu lo hare ze kotesh venoten lakkohen et hazzera veet hatteven. umippene ma kenasuhu lichtosh mippene shellakach hammaaser shibbolim vehifkia mimmennu teruma gedola:

Ben yisrael sheamar lelevi kach amar li abba maaser lecha beyadi en choshshin litrumat maaser shebbo. shehare aviv hifrish terumato ulefichach tzivvahu shezze hammaaser lifloni hallevi. veim amar lo kach amar li abba kor maaser yesh lecha beyadi choshshin litrumat maaser shebbo:

Terumat maaser shehaya bah echad mishshemona bishminit molichah lakkohen. pachot mikken eno metappel leholichah ella mashlichah baur vesorfah. uveyayin uveshemen afillu kol shehu molichah lakkohen. uvilvad shettehe terumat maaser vaddait utehora. aval im hayta temea o shehayta shel demay im en bah kashshiur eno metappel bah ella sorfah:

En tormin teruma gedola ella min hammukkaf. ketzad. hayu lo chamishshim sea bevayit ze vachamishshim sea bevayit acher lo yafrish meechad mehen shete seim al hammea. shennimtza mafrish mimmakom ze al makom acher. veim hifrish shello min hammukkaf terumato teruma vehu sheyyihye hammufrash shamur aval im haya taun kadde yayin o shemen veraa shemmishtabberin veamar hare hen teruma al perot shebbeveti lo amar kelum:

Perot hamefuzzarin betoch habbayit o shete megurot shebbevayit echad torem meechad al hakkol. sakke tevua veiggule devela vechaviyyot shel gerogarot im hayu bahakefa achat torem meachat al hakkol. chaviyyot shel yayin ad shello satam et pihen torem meechad al hakkol. mishshessatam torem mikkol achat veachat:

Haya melakket gappe yarak umanniach bagginna torem meechad al hakkol. hevi min echad benehen torem mikkol echad veechad. hevi minin harebe bakkuppa keruv millemala ucheruv millematta umin acher baemtza lo yitrom min haelyon al hattachton. veim hikkif chamishsha tzibburim begoren torem meechad al hakkol bizman sheikkar haggoren kayyam. en ikkar haggoren kayyam torem mikkol echad veechad:

Terumat maaser mafrishin oto shello min hammukkaf shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 28 29)</small> "mikkol maserotechem tarimu teruma" afillu maaser echad bimdina zo umaaser echad bimdina acheret mafrish teruma meechad al hakkol. vetalmide chachamim en tormin ella min hammukkaf vaafillu terumat maaser:

Ben levi shehaya lo maaser rishon shello nittela mimmennu terumato vehinnicho lihyot mafrish alav veholech vehu betivlo ma sheasa asuy. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 24)</small> "ki et masar bene yisrael asher yarimu laAdonai teruma" melammed shehu ose et kullo teruma leacher:

Hifrish mimmennu terumat maaser techilla veachar kach hinnicho lihyot mafrish alav veholech ad sheyyaase kullo terumat maaser veyitteno lakkohen lo asa kelum. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 29)</small> "et mikdesho mimmennu" bizman shekkadashav betocho ose oto teruma laacherim. en kadashav betocho eno ose oto teruma laacherim. vechen hammanniach perot lihyot mafrish alehem teruma gedola tzarich sheyyihyu tevulin litruma. veim hinnichan lihyot mafrish alehen maaser tzarich sheyyihyu tevulin lemaaser:

Keshemmafrishin teruma umaaser mafrishin otan al hasseder. ketzad. mafrish bikkurim techilla lakkol. veachar kach teruma gedola. veachar kach maaser rishon. veachar kach maaser sheni o maaser ani. vehammakdim sheni larishon. o maaser litruma. o teruma levikkurim. af al pi sheavar al lo taase ma sheasa asuy. uminnayin shehu belo taase shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 28)</small> "meleatcha vedimacha lo teacher". lo teacher davar sherauy lehakedimo. veen lokin al lav ze:

Harotze lehaferish teruma gedola uterumat maaser keechad mafrish echad mishsheloshim ushelosha ushelish. veomer echad mimmea sheyyesh kan hare hu betzad ze shehifrashti vahare hu chullin. vehannishar mizze shehifrashti hu teruma al hakkol. vehammaaser sherauy lihyot lemea chullin ellu hare hu betzad ze shehifrashti. veze hannishar yeter al hatteruma mimma shehifrashti hare hu terumat maaser al hakkol:
Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 4:
Ose adam shaliach lehaferish lo terumot umaasrot shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 28)</small> "ken tarimu gam attem" lerabbot sheluchachem. veen osin shaliach akkum shenneemar gam attem ma attem bene berit af sheluchachem bene berit: 
Chamishsha lo yitromu veim tarmu en terumatan teruma. hacheresh. vehashshote. vehakkatan. vehaakkum shettaram et shel yisrael vaafillu birshuto. vehattorem et sheeno shello shello birshut habbealim. aval hattorem mishshello al shel acherim hare zo teruma vetikken perotehem. vetovat hanaa shello shennotnah lechol kohen sheyyirtze: 
Hattorem shello birshut o sheyyarad letoch sede chavero velikket perot shello birshut kede sheyyikkachem vetaram. im ba baal habbayit veamar lo kallech etzel yafot. im hayu sham yafot mimma shettaram terumato teruma shehare eno makpid. veim lo hayu sham yafot en terumato teruma shello amar lo ella al derech michuy. veim ba baal habbayit velikket vehosif ben yesh lo yafot mehen ben en lo terumato teruma: 
Chamishsha lo yitromu veim tarmu terumatan teruma. cheresh medabber veeno shomea mippene sheeno shomea habberacha. vehaillem sheshshomea veeno medabber. vehearum. mippene sheenan yecholin levarech. vehashshikkor vehassuma mippene sheenan yecholin lechavven ulehafrish et hayyafe: 
Katan shehiggia leonat nedarim af al pi shello hevi shete searot velo naasa gadol im taram terumato teruma. vaafillu bitruma shel tora hoil venidrehen vehekdeshan kayyamin min hattora kemo shebbearnu bindarim: 
Haomer lishlucho tze uterom li vehalach litrom veeno yodea im taram veim lo taram uva umatza keri tarum en chezkato tarum. sheen omrin beissurin chezkat shaliach ose shelichuto lehakel ella lehachamir vechoshesh shemma acher taram shello birshut: 
Haomer lishlucho tze uterom torem kedato shel baal habbayit. im haya yodea bo shehu baal ayin raa mafrish echad mishshishshim. veim haya baal nefesh sevea mafrish echad mearbaim. veim eno yodea dato mafrish lo benonit echad mechamishshim. nitkavven levenonit vealta beyado echad mearbaim o echad mishshishshim terumato teruma. veim nitkavven lehosif al habbenonit vetaram afillu echad mittishim vetisha en terumato teruma: 
Perot hashshuttafin chayyavot bitruma umaasrot shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 28)</small> "maserotechem" afillu shel shenayim. vehashshuttafin enan tzerichin littol reshut ze mizze. ella kol hattorem mehen terumato teruma. taram echad mehen uva hashsheni vetaram teruma sheniyya shehare lo yada shechavero taram. im hayu memachin ze al ze terumat hashsheni enah teruma. veim lo hayu memachin vetaram harishon kashshiur (en terumat hashsheni teruma lo taram harishon kashshiur) terumat shenehen teruma: 
Haomer leshuttafo o leven beto o leavdo o leshifchato litrom. vehalchu litrom uvittel shelichuto kodem sheyyitromu. im lo shinna hashshaliach terumato teruma. veim shinna kegon sheamar lo terom min hatztzafon vetaram min haddarom hoil uvittel shelichuto mikkodem enah teruma: 
Aris shettaram uva baal habbayit veikkev im ad shello taram ikkev en terumato teruma veim mishshettaram ikkev terumato teruma. vehaappotroppesin tormin minnichse yetomim: 
Haggannav vehaggazlan vehaannas terumatan teruma. veim hayu habbealim rodfin acharehen en terumatan teruma: 
Habben vehassachir vehaeved vehaishsha tormin al ma shehen ochlin. aval lo yitremu al hakkol sheen adam torem davar sheeno shello. habben kesheochel im aviv vehaishsha beissatah tormin mippene shehen birshut: 
Happoalim en lahen reshut litrom shello middaat baal habbayit. chutz min haddorchin begat sheim yirtzu letamme et hayyayin hare hen metammeim miyyad. ulefi shemmasar lahen veheeminan al ken hare hen kishluchin veim tarmu terumatan teruma: 
Poel sheamar lo baal habbayit kenos li garni uterom vetaram veachar kach kanas terumato teruma: 
Haakkum shehifrish teruma mishshello din tora sheenah teruma lefi sheenan chayyavin. umiddivrehen gazru shettihye terumato teruma mishshum baale kisin. shello yihye ze hammamon shel yisrael veyitle oto beakkum kede lefatro. uvodkin et haakkum shehifrish teruma im amar bedaat yisrael hifrashtiha tinnaten lechohen. veim lav teuna geniza shemma belibbo lashshamayim. bamme devarim amurim beeretz yisrael. aval akkum shehifrish teruma bechutza laaretz lo gazru alehen umodiin oto sheeno tzarich veenah teruma kelal: 
Hammitkavven lomar teruma veamar maaser. maaser veamar teruma. lo amar kelum. ad sheyyihye piv velibbo shavin. hifrish teruma bemachashavto velo hotzi bisfatav kelum hare zo teruma shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 27)</small> "venechshav lachem terumatchem kaddagan min haggoren" bemachashava bilvad tihye teruma: 
Hammafrish teruma al tenay im nitkayyem hattenay hare hi teruma. veim lav enah teruma. vechen hammafrish teruma umaasrot venicham alehen hare ze nishal lechacham umattir lo kederech shemmattirin lo shear nedarim. vetachazor chullin kemo shehayta ad sheyyafrish paam sheniyya otah shehifrish techilla o perot acherot: 
Hattorem bor shel yayin veamar hare zo teruma al menat shettaale shalem [tzarich shettaale] shalem min hashshever umin hashsheficha aval lo min hattuma. veim nishbera enah medammaat. hinnichah bemakom sheim tishshaver sham o titgalgel lo taggia labbor hare zo medammaat shekkevar nitkayyem hattenay: 
Bamme devarim amurim bitruma gedola. aval bitrumat maaser shemmuttar litrom shello min hammukkaf kevan shealta nitkayyem tenao vahare hi terumat maaser veaf al pi shennishbera o shennishpecha veen tzarich lomar shennitmet: 
Haomer shellemala teruma veshellematta chullin o shellemala chullin veshellematta teruma devarav kayyamin shehaddavar taluy bedaat hattorem: 
Hattorem et haggoren tzarich sheyyechavven et libbo shettihye zo teruma al hakkeri veal ma shebbakkutein veal ma shebbatztzedadin veal ma shebbetoch hatteven. hattorem et hayyekev tzarich sheyyechavvin et libbo litrom al ma shebbachartzannin veal ma shebbazzaggin. hattorem et habbor shel yayin tzarich sheyyechavven et libbo litrom al ma shebbaggefet. veim lo nitkavven ella taram setam niftar hakkol. shettenay bet din hu shehatteruma al hakkol. hattorem kalkala shel teenim venimtzeu teenim betzad hakkalkala hare ellu peturin mippene shebbelibbo litrom al hakkol:
Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 5:
En tormin ella min hayyafe shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 30)</small> <small>(Bamidbar 18 32)</small> "baharimchem et chelbo mimmennu". veim en sham kohen torem min hammitkayyem af al pi sheyyesh sham yafe sheeno mitkayyem. ketzad. torem teenim al haggerogarot. uvemakom sheen sham kohen torem gerogarot al hatteenim. veim ragil laasot teenim gerogarot torem min hatteenim al haggerogarot afillu bemakom sheen sham kohen. aval bemakom sheyyesh bo kohen en tormin min haggerogarot al hatteenim afillu lemakom sheddarkan laasot teenim gerogarot: 
Tormin batzal shalem af al pi shehu katan. aval lo chatzi batzal af al pi shehu gadol. bechol makom en tormin mimmin al sheeno mino shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 27)</small> "kaddagan min haggoren vechamlea min hayyekev". veim taram en terumato teruma: 
Hakkeshut vehammelaffon min echad. kol min chittim echad. kol min teenim ugerogarot udevela echad. vetorem mizze al ze. vechol shehu kilayim bachavero lo yitrom mizze al ze afillu min hayyafe al hara. ketzad. hayu lo chamishshim sea chittin vachamishshim sea seorim bevayit echad vehifrish al hakkol shene sein chittin enan teruma. vechol sheeno kilayim bachavero torem min hayyafe al hara aval lo min hara al hayyafe. veim taram terumato teruma chutz min hazzonin al hachittim mippene sheenan ochel adam: 
En tormin middavar shennigmera melachto al davar shello nigmera melachto. velo middavar shello nigmera melachto al davar shello nigmera melachto. velo middavar shello nigmera melachto al davar shennigmera melachto. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 27)</small> "kaddagan min haggoren vechamlea min hayyekev" min haggamur al haggamur. veim tarmu terumatan teruma: 
Meematay tormin et haggoren mishsheyyivror. barar miktzat tormin min habbarur al sheeno barur. hammachnis shibbolim letoch beto laasotan melilot hare ze torem min shibbolim: 
Meematay tormin et haggat mishsheyyehallechu bah sheti vaerev. meematay tormin et hazzetim mishsheyyitanu: 
En tormin min hattahor al hattame veim taram terumato teruma. vahalacha lemoshe missinay sheiggul shel devela shennitma miktzato tormin lechattechilla min hattahor shebbo al hattame shebbo. velo haiggul bilvad shehu guf echad ella afillu agudda shel yarak afillu aremot shel chittim shennitmea miktzatah tormin min hattahor shebbah al hattame shebbah. aval im hayu shene iggulim o shete aguddot o shete aremot achat temea veachat tehora betziddah lo yitrom min hattahor al hattame lechattechilla. vetormin terumat maaser min hattahor al hattame lechattechilla shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 29)</small> "et mikdasho mimmennu" tol min hamekuddash shebbo: 
En tormin min hattame al hattahor veim taram beshogeg terumato teruma. bemezid lo tikken et hashsheyarim veze sheherim teruma veyachazor veyitrom. bamme devarim amurim shello yada battuma. aval im yada veshagag shemmuttar litrom min hattame al hattahor hare hu kemezid. vechen bitrumat maaser: 
En tormin min hamechubbar al hattalush velo min hattalush al hamechubbar. ketzad. hayu lo perot telushin veamar perot ellu yihyu teruma al perot ellu hamechubbarim afillu (amar) lichsheyyittalshu. o shehayu lo shete arugot veamar perot aruga zo telushin yihyu teruma al perot aruga zo mechubbarim. o sheamar perot aruga zo mechubbarim yihyu teruma al perot aruga zo telushin lo amar kelum. aval im amar perot aruga zo telushin yihyu teruma al perot aruga zo lichsheyyittalshu venitleshu hoil uveyado letalshan eno mechussar maase velichsheyyittalshu shenehem devarav kayyamin. vehu sheyyaviu shetehen shelish beet sheamar: 
En tormin min hallach al hayyavesh velo min hayyavesh al hallach. veim taram terumato teruma. ketzad. likket yarak hayyom velikket mimmennu lemachar en tormin mizze al ze ella im ken darko lehishtammer shene yamim. vechen yarak sheddarko lehishtammer shelosha yamim kegon hammelaffonot kol shellikket bishloshet yamim mitztaref vetorem mizze al ze. yarak sheddarko lehishtammer yom echad bilvad velikket beshacharit velikket baerev torem mizze al ze: 
En tormin mipperot shana zo al perot shana sheavra. velo mipperot shana sheavra al perot shana zo. veim taram enah teruma shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 22)</small> "shana shana". likket yarak erev rosh hashshana ad shello baa hashshemesh vechazar velikket achar shebbaa hashshemesh en tormin mizze al ze shezze chadash veze yashan. vechen im likket etrog beerev 15 bishvat ad shello ba hashshemesh vechazar velikket etrog acher mishshebbaa hashshemesh en tormin mizze al ze mippene sheechad betishre rosh hashshana lemaasrot tevua vekitniyyot virakot. vetv bishvat rosh hashshana lemaasrot hailan: 
En tormin perot haaretz al perot chutza laaretz. velo mipperot chutza laaretz al perot haaretz. [velo mipperot haaretz al perot sureya. velo mipperot sureya al perot haaretz]. velo mipperot sheenan chayyavin bitruma kegon leket shichcha ufea. o perot shennitrema terumatan al perot shechayyavin bitruma. velo mipperot shechayyavin bitruma al perot happeturin. veim taram enah teruma: 
Hammafrish teruma mimmaaser rishon shello nittela terumato. o mimmaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu al perot acherot en terumatan teruma: 
En tormin middavar shehu chayyav min hattora al davar shehu chayyav middivrehen velo min hamechuyyav middivrehen al hachayyav min hattora. veim taram terumato teruma veyachazor veyitrom: 
Atzitz nakuv hare hu keeretz. vechamma yehe bannekev kede shoresh katan vehu pachot mikkezayit. zara tevua beatzitz sheeno nakuv vehevia shelish veachar kach nikkevo venigmera hattevua vehu nakuv hare hu katztzomeach besheeno nakuv ad sheyyikkevennu kodem sheyyavi shelish: 
Hattorem mipperot haggedelin beeretz al haggedelin beatzitz nakuv o mipperot atzitz nakuv al haggedelin baaretz terumato teruma. taram mishsheeno nakuv al hannakuv terumato teruma veyachazor veyitrom. taram min hannakuv al sheeno nakuv terumato teruma velo teachel ad sheyyotzi aleha teruma umaasrot mimmakom acher: 
Hattorem min haddemay al haddemay umin haddemay al havvadday terumato teruma veyachazor veyitrom mikkol echad veechad bifne atzmo. taram min havvadday al haddemay terumato teruma velo teachel ad sheyyotzi aleha teruma umaasrot: 
En tormin shibbolim al hachittim. vezetim al shemen. vaanavim al yayin. veim taram enah teruma gezera shemma yatriach hakkohen lidroch velichtosh. aval tormin shemen al hazzetim hannichbashin veyayin al anavim laasotan tzimmukin. lema ze dome letorem mishshene minin sheenan kilayim ze baze min hayyafe al hara. vechen tormin mizzete shemen al zete kevesh. aval lo mizzete kevesh al zete shemen. miyyayin sheeno mevushshal al hamevushshal. aval lo min hamevushshal al sheeno mevushshal. min hatztzalul al sheeno tzalul. aval lo mishsheeno tzalul al hatztzalul. mitteenim al gerogarot beminyan. miggerogarot al hatteenim bemidda. aval lo teenim al gerogarot bemidda. velo gerogarot al hatteenim beminyan. kede sheyyitrom leolam been yafa. vetormin chittim al happat. aval lo min happat al hachittim lefi cheshbon. uvechol ellu im taram terumato teruma: 
En tormin shemen al hazzetim hannichtashin. velo yayin al anavim hannidrachot shezze dome letorem middavar shennigmera melachto al davar shello nigmera melachto. veim taram terumato teruma veyachazor veyitrom min hazzetim vehaanavim bifne atzman. harishona medammaat bifne atzmah vehaochlah chayyav aleha kishar terumot gemurot aval lo min hashsheniyya: 
Mi shettaram shemen al zetim sheddato leachlan. o zetim al zetim vedato al hakkol laachila. o shettaram yayin al anavim shehem laachila. o anavim al anavim vehakkol laachila. venimlach ledarchan vedarach hazzetim vehaanavim shekkevar taram alehem. eno tzarich lachazor velitrom: 
En tormin chometz al yayin. aval tormin yayin al chometz. shehayyayin vehachometz min echad hen. (haya belibbo litrom min hayyayin al hayyayin venimtza beyado chometz enah teruma). haya belibbo litrom chometz al chometz venimtza hachometz shettaram yayin terumato teruma: 
Hattorem chavit shel yayin al hayyayin venimtza chometz im yodea shehayta chometz ad shello teramah enah teruma. veim achar shetteramah hechmitza hare zo teruma. veim safek teruma veyachazor veyitrom. vechen hattorem kishshut venimtzet mara avattiach venimtza saruach o shennimtzeu nekurin. taram chavit shel yayin venimtzet megulla sheasur lishtotah teruma veyachazor veyitrom sheniyya. veen achat mishshetehen medammaat bifne atzmah. vehaochel achat mishshetehen eno chayyav chomesh: 
Ketzad. nafla achat mehen al hachullin enah medammaat. nafla sheniyya lemakom acher enah medammatah. naflu shetehen lemakom echad medammeot bakketanna shebbishtehen. vechen im achal zar shetehen meshallem bakketanna shebbishtehen vechumshah. vechetzad hu ose bishtehen notnan lechohen echad venotel min hakkohen deme haggedola: 
Habbodek et hechavit vehinnichah lehaferishah teruma al acherim ad shettease kullah teruma veyittenenna lakkohen. uleachar zeman bedakah umetzaah chometz. meet shebbedakah techilla ad shelosha yamim vadday yayin vechol yayin shechashav otan hayyamim shehatteruma shello bechavit zo hare hu metukkan. mikkan veelach safek vetzarich lehaferish mimmennu teruma sheniyya: 
Bishlosha perakim tzarich livdok et hayyayin shehinnicho lifrosh alav shemma hechmitz. veellu hen. bekaddim shel motzae hechag. uvehotzaat hassemadar. uvishat kenisat mayim labboser. veyayin miggitto mafrishin alav bechezkat shehu yayin [ad] arbaim yom: 
Hammanniach perot lihyot mafrish alehen ad sheyyeasu teruma af al pi sheen mafrishin lechattechilla ella min hammukkaf im hifrish hare hen bechezkat kayyamin. metzaan sheavdu hare ze choshesh lechol ma shettikken shemma lo hifrish alehen ella achar sheavdu lefichach mafrish teruma sheniyya:
Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 6: Teruma uterumat maaser neechelet lechohanim ben gedolim ben ketannim ben zecharim ben nekevot hem veavdehem hakkenaanim uvehemtan. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 11)</small> "vechohen ki yikne nefesh kinyan kaspo" vegomer. eved kohen shebbarach veeshet kohen shemmarda hare ellu ochlin:

Teruma shel tora en ochel otah ella kohen meyuchas. aval kohane chazaka ochlin bitruma shel divrehen bilvad. uteruma tehora ben teruma gedola ben terumat maaser ben shel tora ben shel divrehen enah nittenet ella lechohen talmid chacham. mippene sheasur leechol teruma temea. vechol amme haaretz bechezkat tuma lefichach notnin teruma temea lechol kohen sheyyirtze:

Yisreelit shennisset lechohen afillu ketanna bat shalosh shanim veyom echad tochal bitruma vechaze veshok. vedin tora shettochal mishshennitarsa shehare hi kinyano. aval asru chachamim shettochal ad shettikkanes lachuppa gezera shemma taachil teruma leaviha uleacheha keshehi arusa bevet aviha:
Chereshet veshota shennisset lechohen enah ochelet bitruma afillu hissiah aviha gezera shemma yissa cheresh kohen chereshet veyaachilenna. lefichach gazru shello tochal chereshet bat yisrael kelal:

Hazzar asur leechol terumot shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 10)</small> "vechol zar lo yochal kodesh" afillu haya toshav kohen o sechiro shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 10)</small> "toshav kohen vesachir lo yochal kodesh". toshav ze sechir olam. sachir ze sechir shanim. veeved ivri hare hu ketoshav vesachir. vechohenet eshet hazzar hare hi kezar shenneemar vechol zar ben hu ben ishto:

Zar sheachal teruma bezadon. ben shehaya tame ben shehaya tahor ben sheachal teruma tehora ben sheachal temea. chayyav mita bide shamayim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 9)</small> "umetu vo ki yechalleluhu". veloke al achilatah. veeno meshallem deme ma sheachal sheeno loke umeshallem. veim achal bishgaga mosif chomesh shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 14)</small> "veish ki yochal kodesh bishgaga veyasaf chamishito" vegomer:

Uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar hi bitrumat hakodashim lo tochel. shene inyanim nichlelu belav ze. sheim tibbael leasur lah vetease zona o chalala kemo shebbearnu behilchot issure bia hare hi asura leechol bitrumot leolam kedin kol chalal shehechalal kezar lechol davar. veim tinnase leyisrael hare hi asura leechol bammuram min hakkadashim shehu chaze veshok leolam af al pi sheggershah o met:

Aval hatteruma ochelet achar sheggershah hayyisrael o met im lo hinniach ben mimmenna. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 13)</small> "uvat kohen ki tihye almana ugerusha vezera en lah veshava el bet aviha kinureha millechem aviha tochel":
Mippi hashshemua lamdu <small>(Vayikra 22 13)</small> "millechem" velo kol lechem. chozeret hi litruma velo lechaze veshok:
Velo hakkohenet bilvad ella afillu leviyya veyisreelit shennivala leasur lah hoil venaaset zona asura leechol bitruma leolam. veaf al pi sheyyesh lah zera mikkohen:

Lefichach hashshevuya enah ochelet bitruma veaf al pi sheomeret tehora ani. vechol shevuya shenneemenet lomar tehora ani o sheyyesh lah ed kede shettihye mutteret levalah hare zo ochelet bitruma. vehannirbaat livhema lo nifsela min hakkehunna veochelet:

Yisreelit sheyyesh lah zera mikkohen ochelet bishvil benah ben zachar ben nekeva vaafillu tumtum veanderoginus vaafillu zera hazzera ad sof kol haolam shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 13)</small> "vezera en lah":

Keshem shezzera yisrael mikkohenet posel otah kach zera kohen miyyisreelit maachil otah veaf al pi shehu zera pasul. ketzad. bat yisrael shennisset lechohen o kohenet leyisrael veyalda mimmennu bat uva al habbat mi shehu erva aleha o shennisset lemamzer umeta habbat vahare hammamzer kayyam. hayta em immo bat yisrael lechohen tochal bitruma. bat kohen leyisrael lo tochal:

Ha lamadta shehi ochelet bishvil zarah veaf al pi sheoto hazzera pasul vaafillu eno yisrael. veen tzarich lomar sheim hayta lah bat mikkohen af al pi shehabbat nesua leyisrael vaafillu nitchallela hare immah ochelet bishvil habbat happesula:

Kayyotze bo hakkohenet sheenah ochelet mippene zarah shemmiyyisrael af al pi sheoto hazzera kohanim. ketzad. bat kohen shennisset leyisrael veyalda mimmennu bat vehalcha habbat venisset lechohen veyalda mimmennu ben. hare ze rauy lihyot kohen gadol maachil et immo ufosel et em immo veaf al pi shemmeta immo vezot omeret lo keven bitti kohen gadol shehu poslani min hatteruma:

Haeved eno posel mishshum zera veeno maachil. ketzad. kohenet shennisset leyisrael o yisreelit shennisset lechohen veyalda mimmennu ben vehalach habben venichbash al hashshifcha veyalda mimmennu eved umet habben vahare haeved kayyam. hayta em aviv shel eved ze bat yisrael lechohen lo tochal bitruma. hayta bat kohen leyisrael tochal sheen ze zera shehaavadim en lahem yichus:

Bat yisrael shennisset lechohen umet velah mimmennu ben vechazra venisset leyisrael lo tochal bitruma. met hayyisrael velah mimmennu ben lo tochal bitruma mippene benah shemmiyyisrael. met benah miyyisrael ochelet bishvil benah harishon:

Bat kohen shennisset leyisrael veyesh lah mimmennu ben vechazra venisset lechohen tochal bitruma. met velah mimmennu ben tochal bitruma. met benah mikkohen asura leechol mippene benah shemmiyyisrael. met benah shemmiyyisrael chozeret levet aviha kinureha veochelet bitruma lo bechaze veshok:

Bat yisrael shennisset leyisrael techilla veyesh lah mimmennu ben vechazra venisset lechohen ochelet bitruma. met velah mimmennu ben ochelet mippene benah haacharon shehare hu maachilah kemo sheheechilah aviv:
Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 7: Kohen tame asur leechol teruma ben temea ben tehora shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 4)</small> "ish ish mizzera aharon vehu tzarua o zav bakodashim lo yochal". e zehu kodesh sheochlin oto kol zera aharon zecharim unekevot heve omer zo teruma. ella shekkol tame haochel teruma tehora chayyav mita bide shamayim. ulefichach loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 9)</small> "veshamru et mishmarti velo yisu alav chet". vetame sheachal teruma temea af al pi shehu belav eno loke shehare enah kodesh:

En hattemeim ochlin bitruma ad sheyyaariv shimshan veyetzu shelosha kochavim benoniyyim, veze haet kemo shelish shaa achar shekiat hachamma shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 7)</small> "uva hashshemesh vetaher" ad sheyyithar harakia min haor <small>(Vayikra 22 7)</small> "veachar yochal min hakkadashim":

Kohen tahor sheachal teruma temea eno loke mippene shehu baase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 7)</small> "veachar yochal min hakodashim" middavar shehu bikdushshato hu sheyyochal kesheyyithar aval davar tame lo yochal af al pi sheyyithar velav habba mikkelal ase ase hu:
Mi shehaya ochel bitruma vehirgish shennizdazeu evarav lehotzi shichvat zera ochez baamma uvolea et hatteruma:

Hacheresh vehashshote matbilin otan umaachilin otan teruma achar sheheeriv shimshan. umeshammerin otan shello yishnu achar hattevila sheim yishnu temeim. ella im ken asu lahem kis shel nechoshet shemma yiru keri:
Rochve gemallim asurin leechol bitruma ad sheyyitbelu veyaariv shimshan shehen bechezkat tuma mippene hachimmum sheharchiva al or haggamal motzi tippa shel shichvat zera:

Hameshammeshet mittatah im lo nithappecha bishat tashmish tovelet veochelet bitruma laerev. veim nithappecha bishat hattashmish hare zo asura leechol bitruma kol shelosha yamim shei efshar lah shello tiflot vetihye temea kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo:

Terumat chutza laaretz hoil veikkarah middivrehen enah asura baachila ella lechohen shettuma yotza alav miggufo. vehen baale kerayin vezavin vezavot veniddot veyoldot. vechullan shettavlu muttarin laachila af al pi shello heeriv shimshan. aval temee magga tumot ben shennaga bemet shei efshar lanu hayyom littaher mimmennu ben shennaga besheretz eno tzarich litbol litrumat chutza laaretz:

Lefichach kohen katan sheadayin lo raa keri uketanna sheadayin lo raata dam nidda ochlin otah tamid belo bedika shechezkatan shello yatza tuma adayin alehem. vehametzora hare hu kemi shettuma yotza alav miggufo vehu sheyyetamme oto kohen meyuchas aval kodem sheyyetammeennu hakkohen tahor hu:

Kohen arel asur leechol bitruma middin tora. shehare neemar <small>(Vayikra 22 10)</small> "toshav vesachir" bitruma veneemar toshav vesachir befesach. ma toshav vesachir haamur befesach arel asur bo af toshav vesachir haamur bitruma arel asur bo. veim achal loke min hattora. mashuch muttar leechol bitruma veaf al pi shennire kearel umiddivre sofrim sheyyamul paam sheniyya ad sheyyerae mahul:
Hannolad mahul ochel bitruma. vehattumtum eno ochel mippene shehu sefek arel. veanderoginus mal veochel:
Hearel vechol hattemein af al pi shehen asurin leechol bitruma neshehen veavdehen ochlin:
Petzua dakka ucherut shafcha hem veavdehen ochlin. uneshehen lo yochlu. veim lo yada et ishto mishshennaasa petzua dakka ucherut shafcha hare ellu yochlu. vechen im nasa bat gerim hare zo ochelet:
Petzua dakka kohen shekkiddesh bat kohen enah ochelet. seris chamma hu veishto vaavadav ochlin. tumtum veanderoginus avdehen ochlin aval lo neshotehen:
Cheresh shote vekatan shekkanu lahen avadim enan ochlin. aval im kanu lahem bet din o appotroppos o shennaflu lahen birushsha hare ellu ochlin:

Anderoginus shennival lefasul min hatteruma ben derech zichruto ben derech nekevuto nifsal milleechol bitruma kenashim. veen avadav ochlin. vechen im nival leanderoginus acher shehu posel beviato leishsha nifsal veeno ochel velo maachil avadav. vehu sheyyivol oto derech nekevuto. aval derech zichruto en zachar posel zachar min hakkehunna:
Eved shel shene shuttafin shehaya echad mehen kohen eno maachil hare ze haeved asur leechol. vechol hammaachil bitruma maachil bechaze veshok:

Bat yisrael shennisset lechohen vehichnisah lo ben avde melog ben avde nichse tzon barzel hare ellu yochlu. vechen avde kohen shekkanu avadim veavde ishto shekkanu avadim yochlu shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 11)</small> "ki yikne nefesh kinyan kaspo" afillu kinyan hakkinyan. vekinyan haochel maachil (acherim) vekinyan sheeno ochel eno maachil:
Bat kohen shennisset leyisrael vehichnisa lo ben avde melog ben avde tzon barzel hare ellu lo yochlu:

Almana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot ben kohenet ben yisreelit vechen shear chayyave lavin vehichnisa lo avde melog veavdi tzon barzel. avde melog lo yochlu af al pi shehu chayyav bimzonotam. veavde tzon barzel yochlu mippene shehem shel baal. nasa sheniyya hi ochelet veavde melog shellah lo yochlu:

Kohenet almana shennitarsa lechohen gadol o gerusha lechohen hedyot hoil vehen meshammerot levia pesula shel tora hare ellu lo yochlu. vechen im nichnesu lachuppa belo erusin enan ochlot shehachuppa posaltan milleechol. nitalmenu o nitgarshu min haerusin chazru lehechsheran veochlot. min hannissuin lo yochlu shekkevar nitchallelu:
Kohenet shemmet balah kohen venafla lifne yevamim sheyyesh bahen chalal lo tochal mippene zikkat hechalal. vaafillu asa bah echad min hakkesherim maamar. sheen hammaamar kone bivama kinyan gamur:

Kohen shennatan get livimto hakkohenet shehare neesra alav vaadayin zikkato aleha hare zo ochelet bitruma mippene shehi meshammeret levia pesula shel divrehen. sheen hagget posel hayevama ella middivrehen. vechen kohenet chalutza o sheniyya shennitarsa lechohen ochelet. kohen hedyot shennasa aylonit hare zo ochelet bitruma:
Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 8:
Haubbar vehayyavam vehaerusin vehacheresh uven tesha shanim veyom echad poslin velo maachilin: 
Haubbar ketzad. bat yisrael hameubberet mikkohen lo tochal bishvil haubbar. uvat kohen hameubberet miyyisrael asura leechol mippene haubbar. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 13)</small> "veshava el bet aviha kinureha" perat limubberet: 
Bat kohen shebba aleha yisrael en choshshin shemma nitabbera ella tovelet veochelet laerev. hayta nesua leyisrael umet balah tovelet veochelet bitruma laerev ad arbaim yom. veim hukkar ubbarah hare zo mekulkelet lemafrea ad arbaim yom. shekkol haarbaim yom eno ubbar ella mayim baolam hu chashuv: 
Bat yisrael shennisset lechohen umet vehinnichah meubberet lo yochlu avadeha bitruma bishvil haubbar. shehayelud hu shemmaachil sheeno yelud eno maachil. lefichach im haya haubbar chalal eno posel haavadim ella ochlin biglal echav hakkesherim ad sheyyivvaled ze hechalal veyeasru haavadim milleechol: 
Hayyavam ketzad. bat yisrael hazzekuka leyavam kohen lo tochal shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 11)</small> "vechohen ki yikne nefesh" veze adayin lo kenaah. uvat kohen hazzekuka leyisrael asura mippene yevamah shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 13)</small> "veshava el bet aviha kinureha" perat leshomeret yavam: 
Yavam kohen shebba al yevimto beones o bishgaga o sheheera bah velo gamar af al pi shekkenaah kemo shebbearnu behilchot yibbum eno maachilah bitruma ad sheyyivol beila gemura beratzon. bamme devarim amurim shennitalmena min haerusin. aval min hannissuin hoil vehayta ochelet tochal bevia zo: 
Haerusin ketzad. bat kohen shennitarsa leyisrael asura leechol shehare yesh lo bah kinyan. uvat yisrael shennitarsa lechohen lo tochal ad shettikkanes lachuppa shemma taachil livne bet aviha kemo shebbearnu: 
Yisrael sheamar lechohenet hare at mekuddeshet li achar sheloshim yom hare zo ochelet bitruma kol hashsheloshim sheadayin lo nitarsa. veim amar lah hare at mekuddeshet li meachshav uleachar sheloshim yom hare zo asura leechol miyyad vechen shear hattenaim kayyotze baze: 
Hacheresh ketzad. kohenet shennisset leyisrael cheresh lo tochal shehare kone betakkanat chachamim shettikkenu lo nissuin. uvat yisrael shennisset lechohen cheresh lo tochal sheeno kone min hattora sheeno ben daat: 
Nitarsa lechohen pikkeach velo hispik lechansah ad shennitcharesh enah ochelet. met venafla lifne yavam cheresh veyibbemah enah ochelet. aval im nesaah keshehu pikkeach venitcharesh hare zo ochelet. met venafla lifne yavam cheresh veyibbemah hare zo ochelet hoil vehayta ochelet battechilla. veeshet cheresh sheyyalda mimmennu hare zo ochelet bishvil benah: 
Ben tesha shanim veyom echad ketzad. mi shennivala leasur lah vehu ben tesha shanim veyom echad hoil uviato bia nifsela min hakkehunna vaasura milleechol bitruma mippene shennaaset zona o chalala kemo shebbearnu. afillu haya shachuf. uvat yisrael shennisset lechohen ben tesha shanim veyom echad af al pi shebbiato bia enah ochelet bishvil hakkatan lefi sheeno kone ad sheyyagdil. safek shehu ben tesha shanim veyom echad safek sheeno. nisset leven shelosh esre shana veyom echad safek shehevi shete searot safek shello hevi. hare zo asura leechol: 
Kol ellu keshem sheen maachilin bitruma shel tora kach en maachilin bitruma shel divrehem gezera shemma yaachilu beshel tora: 
Veellu lo poslin velo maachilin. haones. vehamefatte. vehashshote shennasa ishsha. ella im ken hayta asura lahen shehen poslin otah beviatam mippene shennaaset zona vachalala kemo shebbearnu: 
Mi shennisset lechohen shote o sheanas otah o sheppitta otah kohen veyalda ochelet bishvil benah. veaf al pi shehaddavar safek hoil uvelo kiddushin hi shemma meacher nitabbera hare havvalad bechezkat ze shebba aleha. vehu shello yatza aleha kol im acher ella hakkol merannenin achareha beze hakkohen. vechen kohenet shebba aleha yisrael shote o sheanasah o pitta otah venitabbera enah ochelet mippene haubbar. nitchattech haubbar hare zo tochal: 
Eshet ish shebbau aleha ede kinnuy veede setira hare zo asura leechol bitruma ad shettishte me hammarim mippene shehi sefek zona. met balah kodem sheyyashkenna. o shehayta min hannashim sheenan shotot velo notlot ketubba. hare zo asura leechol bitruma leolam. vechol eshet kohen sheamra temea ani hare zo asura leechol bitruma: 
Ketanna bat yisrael shennisset lechohen shello middaat aviha ben bifne aviha ben shello befanav af al pi shekkiddeshah aviha enah ochelet bitruma. sheim micha tease zara lemafrea. veze sheroe veshotek koes hu lefi shennisset shello ledato:
Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 9:
Haisha ochelet bitruma ad sheyyaggia get leyadah o leyad sheluchah sheasta lekabbala. vechol shehi sefek gerusha hare zo lo tochal. haishsha sheasta shaliach lekabbel lah gittah asura leechol bitruma miyyad. veim amra kabbel li gitti bemakom peloni enah asura ad sheyyaggia shaliach leoto makom. shalcha shaliach lehavi lah gittah ochelet bitruma ad sheyyaggia get leyadah. haomer leishto hare ze gittech shaa achat kodem lemitati asura leechol bitruma miyyad: 
Ir shehikkifuha karkom usefina hammittarefet bayyam vehayyotze liddon hare ellu bechezkat kayyamin. veen tzarich lomar mefaresh veyotze beshayyara. aval ir shekkevashuha karkom usefina sheavda bayyam vehayyotze lehareg mibbatte dine akkum umi sheggerarattu chayya o nafla alav mappolet o shetafo nahar notnin lo chumre metim vechumre chayyim. lefichach im hayu neshotehen bat kohen leyisrael o bat yisrael lechohen hare ellu lo yochlu. aval mi shennigmar dino bevet din vehinnichuhu bevet hassekila lehareg hare ze bechezkat met velo tochal ishto: 
Hinnicha balah goses bimdina acheret ben shehayta kohenet eshet yisrael o yisreelit eshet kohen lo tochal sherov gossin lemita. echad omer met veechad omer lo met hare zo lo tochal: 
Amra lah tzaratah o achat mehechamesh nashim sheenan neemanot lehaidah shemmet balah hoil veenah nisset al pihen hare zo ochelet bitruma bechezkat shebbalah kayyam. ad sheyyaid lah mi shehu neeman lehassiah al piv: 
Hameshachrer et avdo mishsheyyezakke lo beget shichrur pesalo milleechol bitruma. vechol eved sheyyatza lecherut vaadayin hu meukkav get shichrur kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot avadim af al pi chen hare hu asur leechol bitruma: 
Hakkotev nechasav leacher vezikka lo al yede acher vehayu bahen avadim veshatak ze shennatnu lo veachar kach tzavach hare ze safek im ze shetztzavach hochiach sofo al techillato vaadayin lo yatzu mershut rishon o ze shetztzavach achar sheshshatak chazar bo. lefichach en ochlin bitruma ben shehaya rabbo sheni yisrael veharishon kohen ben shehaya rabbo rishon yisrael vehashsheni kohen:
