Keshehu mechashshev ma shavim happerot shehifrish yesh lo lechashshev kashshaar hazzol veeno choshesh mishshum ribbit. veen hashsheviit meshammetet chov ze. veim ba baal habbayit lachazor eno chozer. aval im ratzu ellu shellakchu hammaot lachazor chozrin. nityaashu mehen habbealim en mafrishin alehen sheen mafrishin al haavud. met hakkohen o hallevi o heani shehilvum eno yachol lehaferish alehen mechelkan kadderech hazzo ad sheyyittol reshut min hayyorshin. vehu sheyyanniach lahen karka afillu melo machat. aval im hinniach kesafim en reshut hayyoresh moelet. veim hilvam bevet din al menat sheyyafrish al maot ellu mechelkam eno tzarich littol reshut min hayyorshin. heeshir heani en mafrishin alav af al pi shehilvuhu bevet din zoche halla bema shebbeyado: 
Yisrael sheamar leven levi kor maaser yesh lecha beyadi rashshay ben levi laasoto terumat maaser al makom acher af al pi shello mashach. veim netano hayyisrael lelevi acher en lo alav ella taromet: 
Mi shehayu lo perot bimgura venatan sea lelevi usea leani lo yafrish shemone sein min hammegura veyochlem. ella im ken yodea sheshshete sein shel maasrot kayyamin. aval im achlu mehen hallevi veheani eno mafrish alehen ella lefi cheshbon hannishar mishshete hassein: 
Aniyyim shehechlifu mattenotehen im baal habbayit kegon shennatnu lo sea shel leket o shichcha ufea umaaser ani venatlu sea min haggoren. ze shennatal mehem patur min hammaaser af al pi shennaasa birshut baal habbayit. veze shennatlu mimmennu chayyav af al pi shehu chelef mattenotehen happeturin: 
Mi shehayu lefanav shete kalkalot shel tevel shennittela terumatan veamar maasrot zo bazo harishona meusseret. amar maasrot zo bazo vezo bazo harishona meesseret shehare kava maasroteha bashsheniyya. veen hashsheniyya meesseret sheen mafrishin maaser min harishona shekkevar niftera al hashsheniyya sheadayin hi chayyevet bemaasar shetehen: 
Amar maasrot shete kalkalot ellu maaser kol achat mehen kavua bachavertah kara shem uchevar kava maasrotehen bahen umotzi hammaasrot shellahen veeno yachol lehotzi alehen maasrot mimmakom acher: 
Vechetzad measseran. motzi maasar shetehen meachat mehen o measser kol achat mehen mimmenna im hayu shavot. veim hayta achat gedola mechavertah mafrish min hakketanna maasar haggedola umin haggedola maasar hakketanna:
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 8:
Happerot shehuram mehen teruma gedola uterumat maaser hen hannikrain chullin. veim hifrish mehen shear maasrotehen hen hannikrain chullin metukkanin bechol makom: 
Tevel shennitarev bechullin metukkanin min bemino shei efshar lehallech achar hattaam. im yesh lo perot acherot motzi al oto tevel teruma umaasrot lefi cheshbon. veim en lo perot acherot lehotzi al oto tevel hare hakkol asur ad sheyyafrish. ucheshehu mafrish mafsid min hachullin hametukkanin kede terumat maaser shebbattevel: 
Ketzad. mea sea shel tevel shennitarev bemea sea shel chullin metukkanin mafrish min hakkol echad umea. vechol shehifrish tevel veyishshaer 99 chullin metukkanin nimtza mafsid sea achat. vechen im haya oto tevel tavul litruma mafsid min hachullin hametukkanin kede teruma uterumat maaser. velamma mafsid sea zo kede shello yomar mea shehifrish hen mea shel chullin vehammea shennisharu hu hattevel. vechen im haya hattevel pachot min hachullin o merubbe al hachullin magbiah hattevel uchede terumat maaser shebbattevel min hachullin o kede teruma uterumat maaser im haya hattevel tavul litruma: 
Vechen im nitarev maaser tavul bechullin metukkanin oser bechol shehu. im yesh lo maaser acher motzi oto al maaser hattavul terumat maaser lefi cheshbon. veim en lo maaser magbiah hammaaser shennitarev umafsid min hachullin hametukkanin kede terumat maaser shebbamaaser hattavul: 
Ketzad. mea maaser shennitarev bemea chullin metukkanin mafrish min hakkol mea veeser vechol shehifrish maaser vehattishim hannisharot hen chullin keshehayu. vechen im hayu hachullin merubbin al hammaaser hattavul o pechutim mimmennu mafrish hammaaser uchede terumat maaser shebbamaaser hattavul min hachullin: 
Tevel shennitarev bemaaser tavul im haya hattevel kamaaser mafsid min hattevel kede terumat maaser shebbo. ketzad. mea sea tevel shennitarev bemea sea maaser mafrish echad umea veze shehifrish maaser vetishim vetesha hannisharot tevel. haya hattevel merubbe al hammaaser mafrish hammaaser bilvad. velo yafsid min hattevel kelum sheim yikra shem litrumat maaser shennitbal nimtza hammaaser medumma bitrumat maaser shel tevel shealta immo. haya hammaaser merubbe al hattevel kore shem litrumat maaser [shebbattevel] umafrish hattevel uchede terumat maaser shel tivlo echad mimmea min hammaaser veyihye hattevel kullo medumma veyimkerenna lechohen chutz middeme shete terumot shebbo venimtza mafsid min hammaaser echad mimmea shebbo shehu kemo terumat maaser shebbattevel. ketzad. mea tevel im matayim maaser mafrish mea veshalosh vehashshalosh hen terumat maaser shel mea tevel veshiur terumat maaser mimmatayim kede shello yavo litot im nitarvu bichmoto veyishshaer 197 vehem maaser keshehayu: 
Mi shehayu lo eser shurot shel eser eser kadde yayin vekava kad echad mishshura hachitzona maaser al makom acher veen yadua e zo shura hachitzona hi. notel shete chaviyyot baalachson umearev shetehen umafrish mehen: 
Kevaah bachatzi shura hachitzona veen yadua e zo chatzi shura hi notel arba chaviyyot mearba zaviyyot. kevaah beshura achat mehen veen yadua e zo shura hi notel shura achat baalachson. kevaah bachatzi shura veen yadua e zo chatzi shura hi notel shete shurot baalachson shehare natal chavit mikkol chatzi shura umearev umafrish: 
Kava hammaaser bechad achat mehen veen yadua e zo hi notel mikkol kad vechad min hammea umearev umafrish kede kad achat umeasser:
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 9: Bime yochanan kohen gadol shehaya achar shimon hatztzaddik shalchu bet din haggadol uvadku bechol gevul yisrael umatzu shehakkol zehirim bitruma gedola umafrishin otah. aval maaser rishon umaaser sheni umaasar ani hayu amme haaretz miyyisrael mekillin al atzman velo hayu mafrishin otan. lefichach gazru shello yehe neeman al hammaasrot ella anashim neemanim. aval amme haaretz perotehen safek veen neemanin lomar meessarin hen. vezehu hannikra demay:

Vehitkinu shello yehe adam mafrish min haddemay ella terumat maaser mippene shehu avon mita. umaaser sheni sheen baze hefsed shehare bealav ochlin oto. aval maaser rishon umaasar ani en mafrish min haddemay mippene shehu safek vehammotzi mechavero alav haraya. lefichach omer lallevi o leani have reaya sheeno meessar vetol maasrot:

Af al pi sheen mafrishin maasar ani min haddemay tzarich likrot lo shem veeno mafrish veomer issur ma sheyyesh kan maasar ani kede likboa maaser sheni shemmaasar ani bishlishit veshishshit bimkom maaser sheni shel shear shene hashshavua:
Keshemmafrishin min haddemay terumat maaser umaaser sheni en mevarchin alehen lefi shehu safek. lefichach muttar lehaferish keshehu erom:

Ketzad measserin et haddemay. mafrish kede terumat maaser shehu echad mimmea min hakkol umannichah betzad happerot veomer ze maaser ushear maaser samuch lo. veachar kach omer ze sheamarti alav shehu maaser hare hu terumat maaser al shear hammaaser hassamuch lo. venotel otah venotnah lakkohen sheeno rashshay lehaferish terumat maaser kodem hammaaser lechattechilla. veachar kach mafrish maaser sheni:

Umuttar lehaferish maaser sheni kodem harishon bidmay. veim ratza omer maaser sheni shel perot ellu bitzfonam o bidromam vahare hu mechullal al hammaot. vechen hallokeach kikkar min hannachtom mafrish mimmenna kede terumat maaser vechalla veomer echad mimmea mimma sheyyesh kan hare hu maaser ushear maaser samuch lo veze sheasiti maaser asuy terumat maaser al hashshear hassamuch lo vehayyeter al echad mimmea sheyyesh baze shehifrashti hare hu challa umaaser sheni bitzfonah o bidromah vahare hu mechullal al hammaot veochel:

Vechen hammazmin et chavero sheyyochal etzlo vehu eno maamino al hammaasrot omer meerev shabbat ma sheani atid lehaferish lemachar hare hu maaser ushear maaser samuch lo. veze sheasiti maaser asuy terumat maaser al shear hassamuch lo umaaser sheni bitzfono o bidromo vahare hu mechullal al hammaot. mippene shemmuttar leadam lehatenot tenaim ellu al haddemay af al pi sheeno birshuto. aval bevadday eno matne ella al davar shebbirshuto:

Ketzad. hayu lo mea teenim shel tevel beveto vehu bevet hammidrash o bassade umityare shemma techshach veeno yachol leasser beshabbat omer shene teenim sheani atid lehaferish hare hen teruma. veeser sheani mafrish acharehen maaser rishon. tesha sheani mafrish acharehen maaser sheni. ulemachar mafrish veochel:

Vetzarich lirchosh bisfatav beshaa shemmafrish zo achar zo veeno kimtakken beshabbat shehare hikdim tenao. vetevel sheyyesh alav tenay ze muttar letaltelo beshabbat kodem sheyyafrish. venoten enav betzad ze veochel et hashshear:

Natan lo am haaretz kos lishtoto omer ma sheani atid leshayyer beshule hakkos hare hu maaser ushear maaser samuch lo veze sheasiti maaser asuy terumat maaser al hashshear hassamuch lo umaaser sheni befi hakkos vahare hu mechullal al hammaot veshote umanniach kede terumat maaser beshule hakkos:

Vechen im zimmeno chavero lishtot beshabbat matne kitnay ze meerev shabbat al kol ma sheyyirtze sheyyisod etzlo. vechen poel sheeno maamin levaal habbayit notel gerogeret achat veomer zo vetesha habbaot achareha asuyot maaser al hammea sheani atid leechol vezo haachat terumat maaser al haeser habbaot achareha umaaser sheni hu haeser haacharonot vahare hu mechullal al hammaot venoten haggerogeret shehifrish lakkohen. vehappoel mafrish leatzmo deme maaser sheni. shettenay bet din hu shettihye terumat maaser mishshel baal habbayit umaaser sheni mishshel poel:

Hannachtomim lo chiyyevum chachamim lehaferish maaser sheni min haddemay ella terumat maaser bilvad kede sheyyafrishenna betohora im hachalla. vehallokeach mafrish maaser sheni. bamme devarim amurim bemocher bachanuto o al petach chanuto. aval hammocher lefalter o bachanut hassemucha lefalter chayyav lehaferish af maaser sheni:

Shenayim shebbatzru karmehen betoch gat achat vehaechad mehem eno neeman al hammaasrot. af al pi sheisser ze hanneeman al chelko keshehu notel chelko min hayyayin chayyav lehaferish mimmennu maaser demay al chelek am haaretz. ketzad. hayu mechetza lemechetza venotel bechetzyo matayim log yayin hare ze mafrish mimmennu log echad terumat maaser veeser maaser sheni keneged hammea log shehare hifrish hammaaser shel vadday techilla al chatzi kol shedderacho baggat. vechen im haya shelish o revia mafrish lefi cheshbon:
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 10: Hamekabbel alav lihyot neeman al hammaasrot velo yihyu perotav demay tzarich lihyot measser et shehu ochel veet shehu mocher veet shehu lokeach. veeno mitareach etzel am haaretz. vetzarich sheyyekabbel alav devarim ellu barabbim. uchesheyyavou edim neemanin shekkibbel devarim ellu barabbim veshehu ragil bahem tamid hare ze neeman al perotav lomar meessarin hen:

Kol talmid chacham leolam neeman veeno tzarich bedika acharav. uvanav uvene beto vaavadav [veishto] hare hem kamohu. talmid chacham shemmet vehinniach perot afillu kenasam beoto hayyom hare hen bechezkat metukkanin:

Bat am haaretz o ishto shennisset lechaver veavdo shennimkar lechaver tzerichin lekabbel alehem battechilla. uvat chaver o ishto shennisset leam haaretz veavdo shennimkar leam haaretz hare hen bechezkatan ad sheyyechashdu. beno o avdo shel chaver shehayu lemudin etzel am haaretz tzerichin lekabbel. beno o avdo shel am haaretz shehayu lemudim etzel chaver kol zeman shehen etzlo hare hen kechaver. yatzu hare hen keam haaretz:
Mi sheeno neeman vehaya echad mibbanav o meavadav neeman o echad mimmishpachto lokchin mimmennu veochlin al pihen veenan choshshin ledavar:

Haya hu neeman veishto enah neemenet lokchim mimmennu veen mitarchin etzlo. [hayta ishto neemenet vehu eno neeman mitarchin etzlo veen lokchin mimmennu. vetavo meera lemi sheishto neemenet vehu eno neeman]:

Lo yeshammesh chaver lo bemishte am haaretz velo bisuddato ella im ken haya hakkol meussar umetukkan mittachat yado. lefichach haroe chaver meshammesh bemishte am haaretz o bisuddato hare hakkol bechezkat metukkan umeussar. rauhu mesev im amme haaretz en hasseudda bechezkat meusseret. shemma hechaver al hattenaim shebbelibbo hu somech:

Keshem sheadam soed etzel am haaretz vesomech al tenao kach hu tzarich lihyot matne al beno vaafillu haya beno bemakom acher. aval eno tzarich lihyot matne al acher chutz mibbeno vaafillu haya immo bemishte. lefichach ben chaver shehaya mesev bemishte am haaretz en hasseudda bechezkat meusseret shemma aviv hitna alav:

Am haaretz shennatan maa lechaver veamar lo kach li aguddat yarak achat o geluska achat lokeach lo setam ufatur milleasser. veim hechelif et hammaa chayyav leasser veachar kach yavi lo. veim peresh hechaver velo lekachan setam ella amar lachenvani agudda zo sheani lokeach mimmecha lachaveri ani kone otah vezo leatzmi ani kone otah. zo shellakach leatzmo chayyav leasserah. vezo shellakach lachavero eno tzarich leasserah. veim nitarvu afillu nitarva achat shello bemea shel chavero metakken hakkol demay. veachar kach yitten lachavero sheshshelacho likkach lo:

Chamishsha sheamru leechad tze vehave lanu chamesh aguddot shel yarak. vehevi lechol echad veechad bifne atzmo. chaverim shebbahen en tzerichin leasser ella al chelkan bilvad. hevi lahen beirbuv chaverim shebbahem tzerichin leasser hakkol:

Am haaretz sheamar lechaver tze velakket li teenim mitteenati ochel mehen hechaver aray umeasseran [demay]. veim amar hechaver leam haaretz lilkot lo veshama chaver acher ze haacher ochel veeno tzarich leasser sheen hechaver motzi davar sheeno metukkan mittachat yado vechezkato shehifrish aleha mimmakom acher. af al pi shello nechshedu chaverim litrom shello min hammukkaf, kede lesallek hammichshol millifne am haaretz tormin:
Muttar lehaachil et haaniyyim veet haorchim demay vetzarich lehodian. veheani atzmo vehaoreach im ratzu letakken metakkenin:
Gabbae tzedaka govin setam mikkol adam umechallekim setam veharotze letakken yetakken:

Rofe chaver shehaya maachil lechole am haaretz mipperot am haaretz noten letoch yado aval lo letoch piv. veim haya haddemay shel rofe afillu letoch yado lo yitten. vechen im yada shehu tevel vadday afillu letoch yado asur:
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 11:
Asur limkor et haddemoy leam haaretz o lishloach lo demay mippene shehu mesayyea laze leechol davar haasur. aval mochrin umeshallechin oto letalmide chachamim sheen talmid chacham ochel ad sheyyeasser o ad sheyyodio adam neeman shezze meussar: 
Kol hammashpiin bemidda gassa kegon hassitonot umochre tevua muttarin limkor et haddemay uleshallecho. mippene shehen mosifin al hammidda hitkinu chachamim sheyyihye hallokeach o ze shennishtallechu lo hu hammafrish maaser demay. aval hammoddin bemidda dakka hoil vehammocher mistakker hu mafrish velo yimkor velo yishlach ella metukkan: 
Vechamma hi midda gassa. beyavesh chatzi sea uvelach midda shemmachzeket sheve dinar meoto davar hallach: 
Salle zetim vaanavim vekuppot shel yarak af al pi shehu mochran achsara asur lemachran demay: 
Amar echad mehen bo unetakken happerot haellu ben shehaya mocher bedakka o begassa hammocher mafrish terumat maaser vehallokeach mafrish maaser sheni vedavar ze tenay bet din hu: 
Chaver veam haaretz sheyyarshu et avihen am haaretz yachol hu lomar tol atta chittim shebbemakom peloni vaani chittim shebbemakom peloni. atta yayin shebbemakom peloni vaani yayin shebbemakom peloni. aval lo yomar tol atta chittim vaani seorim. tol atta hallach vaani hayyavesh. mippene shezze mocher demay: 
Mi shehaya nose yarak vechaved alav massao veratza lehashelich mimmennu al hadderech kede lehakel mimmassao. lo yashlich ad sheyyeasser. kede shello tehe takkala leamme haaretz sheochlin oto bidmay: 
Hallokeach yarak min hashshuk umashach af al pi shello shakal velo madad velo natan damim venimlach lehachazir levaal hachanut lo yachazir ad sheyyeasser: 
Hammotze perot badderech. im rov machnisin levattehen patur milleasser sheadayin lo nikba lemaaser. veim rov machnisin limkor bashshuk hare ellu demay. umechetza lemechetza demay: 
Netalan leachlan venimlach lehatzenia lo yashhe otan ad sheyyeasser kede shello yihye takkala laacherim. veim netalam mittechilla shello yovdu hare ze muttar lashhotan etzlo ad sheyyirtze leachlan o leshalchan o lemachran viasser otan demay: 
Kenivat yarak hannimtzet bagginna hare zo petura min haddemay. veshel baal habbayit hannimtzet babbayit chayyevet. sheal gabbe haashpa bechol makom mutteret: 
Hannoten lefundakit levashshel lo veleefot lo measser et shehu noten lah kede shello yihye takkala laacherim. umeasser et shehu notel mimmenna mippene shehi chashuda lehachalif shel ze [baze]. aval hannoten lachamoto ben shennasa bittah ben sheersah o lishchento pat leefot vetavshil levashshel eno choshesh lo mishshum maaser velo mishshum sheviit mippene sheenah chashuda lehachalif. bamme devarim amurim bizman shennatan lah seor leisa vetavlin likdera. aval im lo natan choshesh mishshum maasrot vechoshesh mishshum sheviit. ulefichach im hayta shenat shemitta asur shemma hasseor missefiche sheviit hu: 
Hammolich chittav letochen am haaretz hare hen bechezkatan sheeno chashud lehachalif. holichan letochen akkum hare hem demay shemma hechelifan bechittim shel am haaretz. vechen hammafkid etzel am haaretz hare hen bechezkatan sheeno chashud lehachalif happikkadon: 
Am haaretz shehaya mishtammesh bachanuto shel chaver af al pi shehechaver yotze venichnas hare ze muttar veeno choshesh shemma hechelif: 
Hammafkid perotav etzel haakkum hare hen keferotav shel akkum shechezkato lehachalif happikkadon. veheach dinam. im hayu perot sheadayin lo nigmera melachtan venigmeru beyad yisrael achar shellakach happikkadon mafrish maasrotav kemo shebbearnu. veim hayu perot shehifkid tevalim venigmera melachtan chayyav lehaferish shemma lo hechelif haakkum. ulefichach yerae li shehammaasrot sheyyafrish safek. aval im hifkid chullin metukkanin eno tzarich lehaferish kelum sheafillu hechelif haakkum peturin kemo shebbearnu behilchot terumot <small>(Devarim 18 4)</small> "degancha" velo degan akkum:
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 12:
Halokeach perot mimmi sheeno neeman al hammaasrot veshachach leasseran venichnesa shabbat o yom tov sheeno yachol leasser hare ze shoalo. veim amar lo meussarin hen ochel al piv beshabbat. vechen im amar lo echad sheeno neeman meussarin hen ochel al piv beotah shabbat. vaafillu hayu lo perot acherot metukkanin meoto hammin mippene sheemat shabbat al amme haaretz veeno over bah avera: 
Af al pi shehu ochel al piv beshabbat hare ze lo yochal meotan happerot lemotzae shabbat ad sheyyeasser demay al hakkol al sheachal beshabbat veal hannishar shello hekellu veheeminuhu ella letzorech otah shabbat. hayta shabbat veyom tov samuch lah ushealo beechad mehen ochel af bashsheni. mippene shello nire leasser bentayim. vechen bishne yamim tovim shel galuyyot: 
Hannishba al chavero sheyyochal immo beshabbat vehu eno maamino al hammaasrot shoel veochel al piv bashshabbat harishona bilvad. aval beshabbat sheniyya af al pi shennadar mimmennu hanaa im lo yochal etzlo lo yochal ad sheyyeasser demay: 
Mi sheeno neeman sherinuhu shehifrish terumat maaser mipperotav shehen demay ureinuhu shechazra venafla befanenu ben lemakom acher ben limkomah vechazar veamar hifrashtiha neeman afillu bechol veochel al piv. keshem sheemat shabbat al amme haaretz kach emat dimmua alehem veenan chashudin lehaachil et hamedumma: 
Mi sheeno neeman sherinuhu shehifrish maaser rishon mipperot ellu veamar shehifrish mehen maaser sheni neeman. hifrish maaser sheni befanenu veamar shehifrish maaser rishon eno neeman shehashsheni shello. vehanneeman al hashsheni eno neeman al harishon. vehanneeman al harishon neeman al hashsheni. lefichach mi sheeno neeman shehotzi perot mibbeto veamar ellu maaser rishon neeman. veen mafrishin mehen terumot umaasrot. veim amar ellu maaser sheni eno neeman vahare hen demay umafrishin mehen terumat maaser. veyerae li shehu pode et kullam: 
Haomer lemi sheeno neeman al hammaasrot kach li mimmi shehu measser vehalach velakach vehevi lo eno neeman. veim amar lo kach li meish peloni hare ze neeman lomar mimmennu lakachti shehare mityare shemma yishalennu. halach likkach lo meoto peloni veamar lo metzativ velakachti lecha meacher shehu neeman eno neeman: 
Hannichnas leir veeno makkir adam sham veamar mi kan neeman mi kan measser veamar lo echad ani. eno neeman. amar lo ish peloni hare ze neeman. velokeach meoto peloni af al pi sheeno makkiro veholech veochel al piv. halach velakach mimmennu veshaal lo mi kan mocher yayin yashan amar lo ze sheshshelachacha etzli af al pi shehen kegomlin ze et ze hare ellu neemanin: 
Bamme devarim amurim bizman sheeno makkir adam sham. aval im makkir adam sham lo yikkach ella min hammumche. veim shaha sham sheloshim yom af al pi sheeno makkir adam sham lo yikkach ella min hammumche: 
Velo hittiru devarim ellu ella bitrumot umaasrot. aval leinyan perot sheviit o leinyan tohorot lo yikkach ella min hammumche: 
Hachammarin shennichnesu lair veamar echad mehen perot ellu enam metukkanim uferot chaveri metukkanin eno neeman shemma kenuneya asu benehen: 
Hammocher perot besureya veamar mishshel eretz yisrael hem chayyav hallokeach leasser. meussarin hen neeman shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir. mishshelli hen chayyav leasser. meussarin hen neeman shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir. veim yadua sheyyesh lo karka besureya vehaya rov mimkaro missadehu chayyav hallokeach mimmennu leasser. shechezkato shemmissadehu heviam: 
Aniyyim sheamru perot ellu shel leket shichcha ufea hare ellu neemanin kol zeman haggoranot shehalleket vehashshichcha vehappea metzuyim. vehu sheyyihye karov min haggoren kede sheyyetze veyavo bo bayyom. veim amru shel maasar ani hem hare ellu neemanin kol hashshana kullah. veenan neemanin ella al davar shedderech bene adam litteno: 
Ketzad. chittim ellu leket shichcha ufea hem hare ellu neemanim. kemach ze shel leket shichcha ufea hu enam neemanin. veen tzarich lomar sheen neemanin al happat lomar mimmattenot aniyyim hu ella mitasserin demay: 
Neemanin al hasseora shel orez veen neemanin alav ben chay ben mevushshal. neemanin al happol veen neemanin al haggerisin ben chayyin ben mevushshalin. neemanin al hashshemen lomar shel maasar ani hu veen neemanin lomar shel zete nikkuf hem. neemanin al hayyarak chay velo mevushshal ella im ken haya davar muat. shekken derech baale battim litten meat yarak mevushshal mikkederato leani. umittoch sheyyachol lomar habbaal habbayit netano li yachol lomar ani bishshaltiv mimmattenotay: 
Vechen ben levi sheamar perot ellu mimmaaser rishon shennittela terumato hem hare ze neeman leolam al terumat maaser keshem sheyyisrael neeman al teruma gedola. aval eno neeman alav lefatro mimmaaser sheni: 
En kol haddevarim haellu amurin ella beam haaretz sheeno lo chashud velo neeman. aval mi shehu chashud limkor teruma leshem chullin asur likkach mimmennu kelal davar sheyyesh bo zikkat teruma umaaser afillu kirve dagim mippene shennotnin bahem shemen. veen asur ella kol shellefanav. aval atzaro muttar likkach mimmennu mippene shehu mityare learev teruma beotzaro shemma yivvada haddavar veyafsid hakkol. vechen hechashud lemaaser sheni lemachran leshem chullin en lokchin mimmennu davar sheyyesh alav zikkat maaser. vechol ze kenas middivrehem: 
Chashud sheheid al shel acherim neeman. chazaka en adam chote velo lo. veen tzarich lomar am haaretz. lefichach am haaretz sheamar ze tevel veze teruma ze vadday veze demay afillu beshello neeman. amar ellu perot metukkanin beshel acherim neeman vehu shello yerau keose kenuneya kemo shebbearnu: 
Hammocher perot lachavero veachar sheyyatzu mittachat yado amar lallokeach perot shemmacharti lecha tevalim hen. habbasar besar bechor haya. hayyayin yen nesech. shurat haddin sheeno neeman afillu haya hammocher chaver vehazzariz machamir al atzmo. veim heemino hare ze meshubbach afillu haya hammocher am haaretz:
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 13:
Perot shechezkatan min hahefikir. kegon hashshitin veharimin vehaozradin uvenot shuach uvenot shikma vehaggufanin venovlot temara vehen sheadayin lo hittilu seor hannitzpa vehakkusbar vechayyotze bahen. peturin min haddemay. vehallokchan meam haaretz eno tzarich lehaferish mehen terumat maaser velo maaser sheni mippene shechezkatan min hahefker. afillu amar lo am haaretz enam meussarin hare ellu peturin min hammaasrot ad sheyyivvada lo shehen min hashshamur: 
Habbechorot vehasseyyayfot shebbevika peturin min haddemay. veshebbeginna chayyavin mippene shehen nishmarin. veellu hen habbechorot. kol happerot shebbikkeru ad shello hoshivu shomer al habbika lishmor peroteha. vehasseyyayfot hen happerot sheyyishshaaru achar sheyyekappelu hammiktzoot shebbassadot veyannichum belo shomer. vechen hachometz heasuy min hattemadim patur min haddemay: 
Kesheggazru al haddemay lo gazru ella al perot haaretz shehecheziku bah ole bavel bilvad shehu mikkeziv velifnim ucheziv atzmah kelachutz. vechol happerot hannimtzaot mikkeziv velachutz peturin min haddemay shechezkatan mipperot makom shennimtzeu bo: 
Perot sheyyadua shehen mipperot haaretz shehecheziku bah ole bavel af al pi shehen nimtzaot besureya veen tzarich lomar baaretz shehecheziku bah ole mitzrayim bilvad hare ellu chayyavin bidmay. umafrishin mehen terumat maaser umaaser sheni. lefichach haddevela hashshemena sheen kemotah ella baaretz shehecheziku ole bavel vechen hattemarim haggedolim vehecharuvin hashshavim vehaorez hallavan beyoter vehakkammon haggadol mitasserin demay bechol eretz yisrael uvesureya. vechen kol kayyotze beferot ellu: 
Hachammarim sheheviu perot letzor chayyavin bidmay shechezkatan mehaaretz shehecheziku ole bavel shehi hakkerova lah. vehaorez en choshshin lo ella kol haorez hannimtza chutza laaretz shehi kerova laaretz shehecheziku ole bavel patur min haddemay ella im ken haya nikkar kemo shebbearnu: 
Hallokeach mibbaale otzarot betzor patur min haddemay veen omrin shemma mipperot haaretz atzaro. vechen chamor yechidi shennichnas letzor vehu taun perot patur min haddemay shechezkatan missede hair: 
Hallokeach mibbaale otzar betzidon chayyav bidmay mippene shekkerova hi yoter mitztzor shechezkatah sheotzrin mipperot haaretz shehecheziku ole bavel. aval hallokeach min hachammarim betzidon patur min haddemay mippene shechezkatan shemmeviin michutza laaretz: 
Hallokeach min haakkum baaretz shehecheziku ole bavel im haya taggar akkum shellokeach miyyisrael hare perotav demay. lefichach barishona bizman shehaya rov eretz yisrael beyad yisrael hallokeach mikkol taggar akkum measser demay kelokeach meam haaretz: 
E zehu taggar ze shehevi shetayim veshalosh peamim. aval im hevi paam achat afillu hevi shalosh massoot bevat achat o shehevi hu uveno ufoel adayin lo huchzak taggar: 
Kesheggazru al haddemay lo gazru al perot chutza laaretz shennichnesu laaretz: 
Perot haaretz sherabbu al shel chutza laaretz hare ellu chayyavin bidmay. veshel chutza laaretz sherabbu al perot haaretz. vechen devarim shechezkatan tadir michutza laaretz kegon egozim vedurmaskaot hare ellu peturin min haddemay: 
Lo halchu chachamim beferot chutza laaretz lo achar hammare velo achar hattaam vehareach ella achar harov kol sherabbu lo muttar veshello rabbu lo asur. ketzad. rabbu bair aval lo bammedina. o sherabbu bammedina velo rabbu bair. bahar velo rabbu babbika. babbika velo bahar. rabbu lachenvani velo levaal habbayit. levaal habbayit velo lachenvani. ze sherabbu bo muttar. umakom shello rabbu bo chayyav bidmay: 
Rabbu perot chutza laaretz bashshuk venitmaatu chazar hashshuk leyashno vehallokeach mimmennu chayyav bidmay: 
Veellu devarim shello gazru alehen beshaa sheggazru al haddemay. hallokeach perot lizria o lehaachil livhema. kemach leorot o limlugema o lirtiyya. shemen lehadelakat hanner o lasuch bo et hakkelim. yayin lekilor. vechallat am haaretz. vehamedumma. vehallakuach bechesef maaser sheni. usheyare hammenachot. vetosefet habbikkurim. kol ellu peturim min haddemay. vechevan sheamar lo am haaretz metukkanin hem eno tzarich leasser: 
Hallokeach perot laachila venimlach alehem livhema hare ze lo yimkerem leakkum. velo yaachilem livhema afillu levehemat acherim ad sheyyetakkenem demay: 
Shemen arev patur min haddemay sheen chezkato laachila. shemen shellakach hassorek letitto betzemer patur min haddemay mippene shehu nivla batztzemer. aval shemen shellokeach haoreg lasuch ben etzbeotav chayyav bidmay mippene shehu nivla begufo vesicha hi kishtiyya bechol makom: 
Akkum sheshshaal miyyisrael litten lo shemen al makkato asur bevadday umuttar bidmay. natan haakkum shemen al gabbe tavla lehitaggel aleha mishsheamad muttar leyisrael leshev acharav: 
Mi shennafal shemen demay al besaro meshafshefo veeno choshesh. hallokeach yayin lemuryas o laalunetit. o kitniyyot laasot techinin chayyav bidmay. aval hallokeach muryas sheyyesh bo yayin o alunetit o shellakach techinin hare ellu peturin min haddemay shello gazru al taarovet demay. veim haya haddavar shechayyav bidmay shennitarev kegon tavlin useor hoil vetaamo nikkar enan betelim venimtzet kol hattaarovet chayyevet bidmay: 
Kol ellu happeturin min haddemay shello gazru alehem. im hitkinan demay vehifrish mehem terumat maaser umaaser sheni ma sheasa asuy. aval im tikken et haddemay bevadday vehifrish mimmennu teruma gedola umaasrot o shettikken et havvadday bidmay lo asa kelum: 
Kol hair mochrin vadday veechad mocher demay velakach veen yadua mimmi lakach ketzad metakken. mafrish teruma uterumat maaser venotnan lechohen umafrish maaser sheni bilvad vahare hu kemaaser sheni shel demay: 
Vechen im hayu lefanav shete kuppot achat tevel veachat metukkan veavda achat mehem hare ze mafrish min hashsheniyya teruma gedola uterumat maaser venotnan lechol kohen sheyyirtze umafrish maaser sheni bilvad bidmay:
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 14:
Halokeach min hassiton vichazar velakach mimmennu paam sheniyya lo yeasser mizze al ze af al pi shehu min echad afillu mikkuppa achat. af al pi shemmakkir et hechavit shehi hi. mippene shehassiton lokeach meanashim harebe umocher. veshemma lakach ze shemmachar techilla meam haaretz shepperotav demay veze shellakach bassof mechaver shepperotav metukkanin. uchevar bearnu sheen measserin min hachayyav al happatur velo min happatur al hachayyav. veim amar hassiton mishshel echad hen neeman: 
Haya mocher keshut o yarak vehen meviin vetzovrin lefanav hallokeach mimmennu measser mikkol keshut ucheshut umikkol agudda vaagudda umikkol temara utemara: 
Hallokeach mibbaal habbayit vechazar velakach mimmennu sheniyya. measser mizze al ze. afillu mishshete kuppot afillu mishshete ayarot. shechezkato sheeno mocher ella mishshello: 
Baal habbayit shehaya mocher yarak bashshuk bizman shemmeviin lo migginnotav measser meechad al hakkol. uvizman shemmeviin lo migginnot acherot im lakach mimmennu vechazar velakach mimmennu paam sheniyya lo yeasser mizze al ze: 
Hallokeach pat min hannachtom lo yeasser min hachamma al hatztzonenet sheani omer chittim shel emesh hayu mishshel echad veshel hayyom mishshel acher: 
Hallokeach min happalter af al pi shehen defusin harebe measser meechad al hakkol. shehannachtom shemmocher lammanpol ose issato defusin harebe. aval hallokeach min hammanpol measser mikkol defus udefus. shehammanpol lokeach mishshene nachtomin: 
Tisha manpolin shellakchu measara nachtomin hoil veechad mehen lakach mishshenayim kol hallokeach meechad min hattisha measser mikkol defus udefus: 
Hallokeach min heani vechen heani shennatnu lo perusot pat o pilche devela measser mikkol achat veachat. uvitmarim uvigrogarot bolel hakkol umeasser. ematay bizman shehammattana merubba. aval bemuetet measser mikkol mattana umattana: 
Shachak et happat vaasaah perurin veet haggerogarot vaasaan devela measser meechad al hakkol: 
Poalim o orchim shehayu mesubbin veochlin vehotiru perusot measser mikkol achat veachat: seliku lehu hilchot maoser besiyata dishmayya
Mishneh Torah, Second Tithes and Fourth:
Achar shemmafrishin maaser rishon bechol shana mafrishin maaser sheni shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 22)</small> "asser teasser et kol tevuat zarecha". uveshana shelishit veshishshit mafrishin maasar ani chelef maaser sheni kemo shebbearnu: 
Beechad betishre hu rosh hashshana lemaasar tevuot vekitniyyot virakot. vechol makom shenneemar rosh hashshana hu echad betishre. uvetv bishvat hu rosh hashshana lemaasar hailanot. ketzad. tevua vekitniyyot shehiggiu leonat hammaasrot lifne rosh hashshana shel shelishit af al pi shennigmeru veneesfu bashshelishit mafrishin mehen maaser sheni. veim lo bau leonat hammaasrot ella leachar rosh hashshana shel shelishit mafrishin mehen maasar ani. vechen perot hailan shebbau leonat hammaasrot kodem 15 bishvat shel shelishit af al pi shennigmeru veneesfu achar ken besof shana shelishit mitasserin lesheavar umafrishin mehen maaser sheni. vechen im bau leonat hammaasrot kodem 15 bishvat shel reviit af al pi shennigmeru veneesfu birviit mafrishin mehen maaser ani. veim bau leonat hammaasrot achar 15 bishvat mitasserin lehabba: 
Vehecharuvin af al pi shechantu perotehen kodem 15 bishvat mitasserin lehabba. hoil umitasserot middivre sofrim. yerae li sheen haddevarim amurin ella becharuve tzalmona vechayyotze bahen sheen reuyin lemaachal rov haadam. vehen hen shemmitasserot middivre sofrim. aval shear hecharuvin yerae li shehen kishar perot hailan: 
Hayyarak bishat lekitato issuro. ketzad. im nilkat beyom rosh hashshana shel shelishit af al pi shebba leonat hammaasrot venigmar bashsheniyya mafrishin mimmennu maasar ani. veim nilkat barviit maaser sheni: 
Vechen haetrog bilvad mishshear perot hailan hare hu keyarak veholchin achar lekitato ben lemaaser ben lishviit. ketzad. im nilkat bashshelishit achar 15 bishvat mafrishin mimmennu maasar ani af al pi shennigmera bashsheniyya. vechen im nilkat barviit kodem 15 bishvat mafrishin mimmennu maasar ani. nilkat barviit achar 15 bishvat mafrishin mimmennu maaser sheni: 
Veaf al pi sheholchin achar lekitato etrog bat shishshit shennichnesa lashsheviit afillu hayta kezayit venaaset kechikkar chayyevet bemaasrot: 
Haevyonot shel tzalaf notnin alehen chumre ilan vechumre zeraim. sheim hayu mishshana sheniyya shennichnesa lashshelishit venilketu kodem 15 bishvat mafrishin maaser rishon veachar kach mafrish maaser acher ufodehu. veachar sheppodehu notno laaniyyim veochel pidyono betorat maaser sheni. venimtza kemo shehifrish maaser sheni umaasar ani: 
Haorez vehaddochan vehapperagin vehashshumshemin af al pi shehishrishu kodem rosh hashshana en holchin bahen ella achar gemar happeri umitasserin lehabba. vechen pol hammitzri af al pi shemmiktzato hishrish lifne rosh hashshana umiktzato leacharav tzover garno letocho vetorem umeasser min hakkol keechad shehakkol holech achar gemar happeri: 
Habbetzalim hassarisim shemmana mehem mayim sheloshim yom lifne rosh hashshana. veshel baal shemmana mehem shalosh onot lifne rosh hashshana. mitasserin lesheavar. mana mehem pachot mikkan af al pi shehitchilu livash kodem rosh hashshana mitasserin lehabba: 
Pol hammitzri shehevi shelish lifne rosh hashshana im zerao lezera mitasser lesheavar. zerao leyarak mitasser lehabba. zaro lezera uleyarak o shezzerao lezera vechishshev alav leyarak measser mizzaro al yerako umirako al zaro. lo hevi shelish lifne rosh hashshana im zerao lezera zaro mitasser lesheavar virako bishat lekitato issuro. vehu shellikket mimmennu lifne rosh hashshana. aval im likket mimmennu achar rosh hashshana ben yerako ben zaro mitasser lehabba. zerao lezera vechishshev alav leyarak holchin achar machashavto. zerao leyarak vechishshev alav lezara en machashevet zera chala alav ella im ken mana mimmennu shalosh arayot. vehu shehevi shelish lifne rosh hashshana aval im lo hevi shelish ella leacharav af al pi shello nimna milleerot mimmennu shalosh arayot. zaro lezera veasa kullo katztzatzin gemurim lifne rosh hashshana zaro mitasser lesheavar. virako bishat lekitato. miktzato asa katztzatzin gemurin umiktzato lo asa. ze sheamru tzover garno letocho venimtza measser mizzaro al yerako umirako al zaro: 
Perot shana sheniyya shennitarvu beferot shelishit. o shel shelishit birviit. holchin achar harov. mechetza lemechetza mafrish maaser sheni min hakkol. aval lo maasar ani shemmaaser sheni chamur shehare hu kodesh umaasar ani chol. vechen perot shehen safek im perot sheniyya hem o perot shelishit mafrish mehen maaser sheni: 
Kol happetur mimmaaser rishon patur min hashsheni umin heani. vechol shechayyav berishon chayyav bishnehem. vechol hattorem motzi maaser. vechol sheeno torem eno motzi maaser ze. kol mi sheim taram terumato teruma kach im isser maaser ze hare hu maaser. vechol mi sheen terumato teruma kach im hotzi maaser ze eno maaser: 
Perot shehotzi mehen maaser rishon kodem sheyyikkavu lammaaser hare ze ochel mehen aray kodem sheyyotzi maaser sheni. sheen harishon kovea lashsheni. aval mishshennikbeu lemaaser af al pi shehotzi et harishon asur leechol mehen aray ad sheyyotzi et hashsheni o et maasar ani: 
Maaser sheni hoil vetaun havaat makom en meviin oto michutza laaretz kivchor behema. lefichach lo chiyyevu lehaferish maaser sheni besureya. veyerae li shemmaaser sheni shemmafrishim beeretz shinar uvemitzrayim podin oto umeviin damav lirushalayim. vechen yerae li shello chiyyevu mekomot ellu bemaaser sheni ella kede likboa maaser ani kede sheyyihyu aniyye yisrael somchim alehem:

Maaser sheni neechol livalav lefanim mechomat yerushalayim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 23)</small> "veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha bammakom asher yivchar leshakken shemo sham" vegomer. venoheg bifne habbayit veshello bifne habbayit aval eno neechol birushalayim ella bifne habbayit shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 23)</small> "masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha uvechorot bekarcha vetzoncha". mippi hashshemua lamdu ma bechor eno neechol ella bifne habbayit af maaser sheni lo yeachel ella bifne habbayit: 
Middat chasidut sheppodin maaser sheni bazzeman hazze beshavyo kederech sheppodin oto bifne habbayit. vehoru haggeonim sheim ratza lifdot sheve mane bifruta lechattechilla bazzeman hazze pode. lo yihye ze chamur min hakkodesh. umashlich happeruta layyam haggadol: 
Vechen im chillel maaser sheve mane al sheve peruta mipperot acherot hare ze mechullal. vesoref et happerot shechillel alehem kede shello yihyu takkala laacherim. kefidyon neta revai bazzeman hazze kemo shebbearnu behilchot issure maachalot: 
Keshem sheen ochlin maaser sheni bazzeman hazze birushalayim kach en podin oto sham. veen mechallelin oto veen mochrin oto. veim nichnas birushalayim af bazzeman hazze en motziin oto mishsham umannichim oto sham ad sheyyerakev vechen im avar vehotzio mishsham mannichin oto ad sheyyerakev. lefichach en mafrishim maaser sheni birushalayim bazzeman hazze ella motziin et happerot betivlan chutz lair umafrishin oto sham ufodehu. veim hifrishu sham bazzeman hazze yerakev: 
Kol haochel kezayit maaser sheni o sheshshata mimmennu reviit yayin chutz lechomat yerushalayim loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 17)</small> "lo tuchal leechol bisharecha masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha" vegomer. veloke al kol echad veechad bifne atzmo. lefichach im achal shelashtan chutz lachoma loke shalosh malkiyyot shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 23)</small> "veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha" masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha veneemar lo tuchal leechol bisharecha masar degancha vegomer lamma peratan velo amar lo tochlem bisharecha lechayyev al kol echad veechad bifne atzmo: 
Eno loke min hattora ad sheyyochlennu achar shennichnas lechomat yerushalayim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 17)</small> "lo tuchal leechol bisharecha" vegomer <small>(Devarim 14 23)</small> "veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha". kevan shennichnas limkom achilato vaachalo bachutz loke. aval im achalo kodem sheyyikkansu lirushalayim makkin oto makkat mardut middivrehem: 
Miktzat maaser bifnim umiktzato mibbachutz haochel mizze sheadayin lo nichnas makkin oto makkat mardut. vehaochel bachutz mizze shennichnas loke: 
En podin maaser sheni birushalayim ella im ken nitma shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 24)</small> "ki yirchak mimmecha hammakom" berichuk makom hu nifde veeno nifde bekeruv makom. haya hu bifnim umassao bachutz afillu haya ochez oto bekane hoil velo nichnas hammaaser hare ze muttar lifdoto sham betzad hachoma: 
Maaser sheni shennichnas lirushalayim afillu shel demay asur lehotzio mishsham shekkevar kelatuhu mechitztzot. vechen perot hannilkachin bechesef maaser shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 23)</small> "veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha". avar vehotzian o sheyyatzu bishgaga yachzeru veyeachlu birushalayim. ukelitat mechitztzot middivrehem afillu maaser sheen bechumsho sheve peruta shehu middivrehem mechitztzot koltot oto veasur lehotzio. aval meot maaser sheni nichnasin lirushalayim veyotzin: 
Perot shennigmera melachtan veavru betoch yerushalayim veyatzu eno yachol lehotzi alehen maaser sheni mipperot acherot shello nichnesu lirushalayim. ella yachazor maaser sheni shellahen veyeachel birushalayim veeno nifde bachutz. afillu asa kol happerot haellu maaser sheni achar sheyyatzu al perot acherot shello nichnesu yachzeru veyeachlu birushalayim. chomer hu bimchitztzot yerushalayim hoil vekaltu kaltu: 
Perot shello nigmera melachtan sheavru birushalayim veyatzu. kegon salle anavim legat vesalle teenim bemuktze. muttar lifdot maaser sheni shellahem bachutz. vechen perot demay af al pi shennigmera melachtan veavru birushalayim veyatzu podin maaser sheni shellahen bachutz: 
Perot maaser sheni shennitmeu birushalayim ufedaan im nitmeu bivlad hattuma asur lehotzian. ella yeachlu bifnim mippene shevvelad hattuma middivrehem. veim nitmeu beav hattuma o shennitmeu bachutz vaafillu bivlad hattuma af al pi shennichnesu lirushalayim hare ellu nifdin veneechalin bechol makom: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshehichnisan al menat shello titpesem hammechitztzot. aval im lo hitna hoil venichnas hare hu tahor min hattora [sheen valad metamme sheni min hattora] uchevar kelatuhu mechitztzot veeno yotze: 
Tiltan shel maaser sheni muttar leachlah tzimchonin shekkach hi reuya laachila. vechen karshine maaser sheni yeachlu tzimchonin. veim asa mehem issa hare zo mutteret lehikkanes lirushalayim ulehotziah sheenan bichlal happerot. veim nitmeu birushalayim yippadu veyeachlu bachutz: 
Ilan sheomed lefanim min hachoma venofo note chutz lachoma en ochlin tachat nofo maaser sheni. umaaser sheni shennichnas tachat nofo en podin oto shehare hu kemi shennichnas lirushalayim: 
Battim shebbetzad hachoma sheppitchehem lefanim min hachoma vachalalan lechutz. mikkeneged hachoma ulefanim kilfanim lechol davar umikkeneged hachoma velachutz en ochlim sham veen podin sham lehachamir. haya chalalan lefanim ufitchehem lachutz. mikkeneged hachoma velachutz kelachutz podin bo veen ochlin. umikkeneged hachoma velifnim en ochlin sham veen podin lehachamir. vehachallonot voovi hachoma kilfanim:

Haochel maaser sheni betuma loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 14)</small> "velo viarti mimmennu betame". ben shehammaaser tame vehaochel tahor. ben shehammaaser tahor vehaochel tame. vehu sheyyochlennu birushalayim kodem sheyyippade. sheeno loke al achilato betuma ella bimkom achilato. aval im achalo betuma chutz lirushalayim makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Vaafillu lehadelik [bo] et hanner achar shennitma asur ad sheyyippade shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 14)</small> "lo viarti mimmennu betame": 
Kevar bearnu shehammaaser shennitma afillu birushalayim podin veyeachel. veochlin et damav betohora betorat perot maaser kemo sheyyitbaer. afillu nitmeu happerot kullan keshehen tevel mafrish maaser sheni betuma ufodehu: 
Hearel ketame veim achal maaser sheni loke min hattora kederech shelloke al achilat teruma. shehatteruma keruya kodesh umaaser sheni karuy kodesh shehare neemar bo <small>(Vayikra 27 30)</small> "kodesh laAdonai". vetame shettaval ochel maaser sheni af al pi shello heeriv shimsho: 
Haochel maaser sheni baaninut shel tora loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 14)</small> "lo achalti veoni mimmennu". vehu sheyyochlennu bemakom achilato birushalayim. aval im achalo bachutz baaninut. o sheachalo bifnim baaninut shel divrehem. makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Ezehu onen ze hammitabbel al echad min hakkerovim shehu chayyav lehitabbel alehen. uveyom hammita hu onen min hattora uvallayla onen middivrehen shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 10 19)</small> "veachalti chattat hayyom hayyitav beene Adonai". hayyom asur velayla muttar. nishtaha hammet yamim rabbim veachar kach nikbar. kol otan hayyamim sheachar yom hammita ad yom hakkevura hu onen middivrehen. veen yom hakkevura tofes lelo: 
Velo maaser sheni bilvad ella kol hakkadashim kullan im achalan baaninut shel tora loke. uvaaninut shel divrehen makkin oto makkat mardut: 
En notnin perot maaser sheni leam haaretz velo perot hannilkachot bimot maaser velo meot maaser mippene shehu bechezkat tuma. umuttar leechol maaser sheni shel demay baaninut velitteno leam haaretz vehu sheyyochal kenegdo. en mafkidin maaser sheni afillu etzel chaver shemma yamut venimtza hammaaser tachat yad beno am haaretz. aval mafkidim maaser sheni shel demay etzel am haaretz: 
Maaser sheni asur leabbed afillu miuto badderachim. ella molicho kol shehu o molich damav lirushalayim. umuttar leabbed miut maaser sheni shel demay badderachim. vechamma hi miut pachot mikkigrogeret ben beochel shalem ben befarus. aval kigrogeret en meabbedin oto. vehammafrish maaser sheni shel demay pachot mikkigrogeret hare ze notno leam haaretz veochel kenegdo aval lo yafrishennu lechattechilla leabbedo sheen mafrishin leabbed: 
Maaser sheni nittan laachila ushetiyya shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 23)</small> "veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha". vesicha kishtiyya. veasur lehotzio bishar tzerachav kegon likkach bo kelim uvegadim vaavadim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 14)</small> "lo natatti mimmennu lemet" kelomar lo hotzeti oto bedavar sheeno mekayyem et hagguf. veim hotzi mimmennu bishar devarim afillu bidvar mitzva kegon shellakach mimmennu aron vetachrichin lemet mitzva hare ze ochel kenegdo betorat maaser: 
Maaser ochel davar sheddarko leheachel veshote davar sheddarko lishtot vesach davar sheddarko lasuch. velo yasuch yayin vechometz aval sach hu et hashshemen. velo yischot et happerot lehotzi mehen mashkin chutz mizzetim vaanavim bilvad. [veen mefattemin et hashshemen aval mefattemin et hayyayin]. veen mechayyevin oto leechol pat sheippesha veshemen shennisrach. ella kevan shennifsal meochel adam paka kedushsha mimmennu: 
Kol shemmuttar lezarim leachlo bitruma kach muttar bemaaser sheni leachlo betorat chullin. shemarim shel maaser sheni shennatan alehem mayim. rishon asur kemaaser vesheni muttar kechullin. veshel demay afillu rishon muttar: 
Yayin shel maaser shennafal letocho devash vehattavlin vehishbichu hashshevach lefi cheshbon. vechen dagim shennitbashshelu im kaflotot shel maaser sheni vehishbichu hashshevach lefi cheshbon: 
Issa shel maaser sheni sheafaah vehishbicha hashshevach lashsheni. ze hakkelal kol sheshshivcho nikkar im hotir bemidda hashshevach lefi cheshbon. veim lo hotir hammidda hashshevach lashsheni bilvad. vechol sheen shivcho nikkar afillu hotir hammidda hashshevach lashsheni bilvad: 
Ketzad hashshevach. lefi cheshbon. yayin shel maaser sheshshave shelosha shennafal letocho devash vetavlin shave zuz echad vehosifa bemiddato vehishbichuhu vahare hakkol shave chamishsha choshvin hakkol bearbaa urevia. vechen al derech ze bishar haddevarim: 
Maaser sheni af al pi shennittan lesicha en notnin oto lo al gabbe tzinit velo al gabbe chazazit. veen osin mimmennu kamea vechayyotze bo shehare lo nittan lirfua: 
Maaser sheni mamon gavoah hu shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 30)</small> "laAdonai hu". lefichach eno nikne bemattana ella im ken natan lo hattevel vehamekabbel mafrish hammaaser. veen mekaddeshin bo et haishsha veen mochrin oto veen memashkenin oto veen machlifin oto veen marhinin oto: 
Ketzad en memashkenin oto. lo yikkanes leveto vimashkenennu maaser sheni shello. avar umishkeno motziin oto miyyado. ketzad en marhinin oto. lo yomar lo he lecha maaser ze veyihye beyadcha veten li alav maot. ketzad en machlifin oto. lo yomar lo he lecha yen maaser veten li shemen maaser. aval omer lo he lecha yayin sheen li shemen veim ratza chavero litten lo shemen muttar shehare lo hechelif immo ella hodio sheen lo veim ratza halla litten yitten: 
Maaser sheni en shoklin kenegdo afillu dinre zahav. vaafillu lechallel alehem maaser sheni acher gezera shemma lo yechavven mimmennu mishkalo venimtzeu happerot chaserim vehu shokel bahen maot lechallel alehem maaser acher nimtza motzi maaser lechullin befachot bedamav: 
Haachim shechalku maaser sheni en shoklin ze keneged ze vechen meot maaser sheni en shoklim kenegdan veen mochrin otam veen machlifin velo marhinin. velo yittenem leshulchani lehitnaot bahen velo yalve otan lehitgaddel bahen. veim hilvan shello yaale chaludda muttar: 
Veen porin mehem et hammilve. en osin mehen shoshvinut veen meshallemin mehen haggemulin. veen poskin mehem tzedaka bevet hakkeneset. aval meshallemin mehen devarim shehen gemilut chasadim. vetzarich lehodia: 
Lo yomar adam lachavero haal et happerot haellu lirushalayim vetol mehen chelkecha shennimtza ze kenotel sachar mimmaaser sheni al havaato lirushalayim. aval omer lo haelem shennochlem veshennishtem birushalayim: 
Omer adam lachavero birushalayim lasuch oto beshemen maaser sheni af al pi shennissocha yado veen ze bischar sichato: 
Kevar bearnu shehammaaser mamon gavoah hu. lefichach anu omrim shehaggonev maaser sheni eno meshallem tashlume kefel vehaggozlo eno meshallem chomesh: 
Hammakdish maaser sheni shello levedek habbayit hare ze pode oto mi sheppodehu al menat litten lahekdesh et shello ulemaaser sheni et shello:

Harotze lifdot perot maaser sheni pode otan bidmehen veomer hare hammaot haellu tachat happerot haellu o happerot haellu mechullalot al hammaot haellu. veim lo peresh ella hifrish maot bilvad keneged happerot dayyo veeno tzarich lefaresh veyetzu happerot lechullin. veyaalu hammaot lirushalayim veyotziem sham shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 24)</small> "vechi yirbe mimmecha hadderech ki lo tuchal seeto":

Vechen im ratza lechallel perot hammaaser al perot acherot. yaalu happerot hashsheniyyot veyeachlu birushalayim. velo yechallel mimmin al sheeno mino velo min hayyafe al hara vaafillu beoto hammin. veim chillel hare hen mechullalot:

Happode maaser sheni mevarech asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al pidyon maaser sheni. veim chillelan al perot acherot o shechillel maot al happerot mevarech al chillul maaser sheni. vehappode o hamechallel maaser sheni shel demay eno tzarich beracha:
Kesheppodin et hammaaser en podin oto leshem maaser ella leshem chullin. veomrin kamma shavin perot chullin ellu veaf al pi shehakkol yodin shehen maaser kede shello yitbazze:

En mechallelin meot maaser sheni al maot acherot. ben shehayu ellu veellu kesef o ellu veellu nechoshet. [o harishonot kesef vehashsheniyyot nechoshet. o] harishonot nechoshet vehashsheniyyot kesef. veim avar vechillel hare ellu mechullalin:

En mechallelin maot maaser al happerot. veim chillel yaalu happerot veyeachlu birushalayim. velo yechallelem al behema chayya veof chayyin. veim chillel lo kana maaser shemma yegaddel mehem adarim adarim. aval im chillel al shechutim hare hen kishar happerot veyaalu veyeachlu birushalayim veyetzu hammaot lechullin:
Bishat haddechak muttar lechallel maot hakkesef al shel nechoshet. lo sheyyekayyem ken ella ad sheyyimtza revach. veyachazor vichallel maot hannechoshet al maot hakkesef:
Maaser sheni shel demay mechallelim oto lechattechilla kesef al kesef vechesef al nechoshet unechoshet al nechoshet unechoshet al happerot veyaalu otan happerot veyeachlu birushalayim:

En podin perot maaser ella bechesef shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 25)</small> "vetzarta hakkesef". vechen im pada leatzmo vehosif chomesh lo yihye hachomesh ella kesef kakkeren. veen podin bechesef sheeno matbea ella bechesef mefuttach sheyyesh alav tzura o ketav [shenneemar vetzarta hakkesef]. veim pada belashon shel kesef vechayyotze bo vehu hannikra asimon lo asa kelum. veen podin befachot mipperuta mippene shehu kefode baasimon:

En podin bematbea sheeno yotze beoto zeman uveoto makom shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 26)</small> "venatatta hakkesef bechol asher teavve nafshecha" ad sheyyihye rauy lehotzaa. umatbea melachim harishonim im yotze mishshemam podin bo:
Eno pode bemaot sheenan birshuto shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 25)</small> "vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha". nafal kiso levor vehu yachol lehotzio pode bo mippene shehu birshuto:

Haya ba badderech umaot beyado veannas ba kenegdo im yachol lehatztzil al yede haddechak pode bahen perot shebbeveto. veim lav veamar perot sheyyesh li betoch beti mechullalin al hammaot hallalu lo amar kelum:
Hammeniach maot lihyot mechallel alehen maaser sheni hare ze pode bahen bechezkat shehen kayyamim. metzaan sheavdu choshesh lechol ma sheppada bahen lemafrea:
Mi shehaya omed bitverya veyesh lo maot (bavel) bevavel eno mechallel alehem. hayu lo maot mimmatbea teverya bevavel mechallel alehem. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Haomer maaser sheni mechullal al sela shettaale beyadi mikkis ze al sela sheefrot middinar zahav ze al punedyon sheefrot missela ze hare ze chillel. vesela shettaale beyado o sheyyifrot tehi maaser:
Amar hare maaser mechullal al sela shehayta beyad beni lo chillel. shemma lo hayta beyado beotah shaa:

Happode maaser sheni kodem sheyyafrishennu kegon sheamar maaser sheni shel perot ellu paduy bemaot ellu lo amar kelum velo kava maaser. aval im kava veamar maaser sheni shellahen batztzafon o baddarom mechullal al hammaot ellu hare ze paduy:

Kesheppodin maaser sheni podin oto beshavyo. veyesh lo lifdot bashshaar hazzol kemot shehachenvani lokeach velo kemot shehu mocher. venoten hammaot kemot shehashshulchani poret lo kemot shehu metzaref. veim avar ufada sheve mane bifruta o chillel sheve mane al sheve peruta hare ze mechullal:
Hayta hassela chasera shetut o pachot mishshetut im hayta yotzet al yede haddechak mechallel aleha lechattechilla bishve sela veeno choshesh. pada besela venimtzet raa yachalifenna:

En podin maaser sheni achsara ella medakdek bemiddato o bemishkalo venoten damav. im hayu damav yeduim yippade al pi echad. veim davar sheen damav yeduim kegon yayin shehitchil lehachamitz uferot shehirkivu o maot shehechelidu yippade al pi shelosha taggarim vaafillu haya echad mehen akkum o baal hammaaser afillu ish ushete nashav podin al pihem. vechofin et habbealim liftoach rishon. veze chomer bemaaser min hahekdesh:

En molichin perot maaser mimmakom lemakom lifdotam sham. vehammolich mimmekom hayyoker lammakom hazzol o mimmakom hazzol limkom hayyoker pode keshaar mekom happediyya. veim hayu demay podin oto kashshaar hazzol hoil veniru lehimmacher bezol:
Hayu lo perot maaser sheni baggoren vehotzi alehem yetziot mibbeto ad shehevian lair vehishbichu. pode keshaar hair vehifsid yetziotav:

Happode maasro leatzmo ben shehu shello ben shennafal lo birushsha ben shennittan lo betivlo mattana kemo shebbearnu. hare ze mosif alav chomesh. im haya shave arbaa noten chamishsha. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 lo)</small> "veim gal yigal ish mimmaasro chamishito yosef alav": 
Veishsha sheppadat maaser sheni shellah leatzmah enah mosifa chomesh. mippi hashshemua lamdu <small>(Vayikra 27 lo)</small> "ish mimmaasro" velo ishsha. vechen im pada pidyon perot hammaaser leatzmo mosif chomesh: 
Pada perot maasro vehosif chomesh vechazar ufada happidyon leatzmo paam sheniyya mosif chomesh sheni al hakkeren bilvad veeno mosif chomesh al hachomesh: 
Maaser sheni sheen bechumsho sheve peruta eno mosif alav chomesh. vechen maaser sheen damav yeduin dayyo sheyyomar hu vechumsho mechullal al hassela hazze. vechol maaser shehu eno podehu mishshello eno mosif chomesh. umaaser sheni shel demay eno mosif alav chomesh: 
Happode maaser sheni vehaya lo maaser sheni acher shello nifda. im en bechumsho sheve peruta dayyo sheyyomar hu vechumsho mechullal al maot harishonot lefi shei efshar leadam letzamtzem et meotav: 
Happode maaser beyoter al damav lo nitpesa hattosefet lamaaser: 
Baal habbayit omer besela veacher omer besela. baal habbayit kodem mippene shehu mosif chomesh. baal habbayit omer besela veacher omer besela uferuta. haacher kodem mippene shemmosif al hakkeren: 
Muttar lehaarim al pidyon maasro. ketzad. omer livno ulevitto haggedolim uleavdo haivri he lecha et hammaot haellu ufede lecha bahen hammaaser kede shello yosif chomesh. aval lo yomar lo pede li bahen. vechen im amar lo pede li mishshellecha eno mosif chomesh: 
Aval lo yitten hammaot lifdot livno ulevitto hakketannim uleavdo veshifchato hakkenaanim mippene sheyyadan keyado. natan leshifchato haivriyya im maaser sheni ze middivrehem kegon shehaya meatzitz sheeno nakuv devarav kayyamin. sheama haivriyya ketanna hi veen hakkatan zoche laacherim ella bedavar shehu middivrehem: 
Vechen maarim venoten hammaaser mattana keshehu betivlo. veomer hannoten hare happerot haellu mechullalin al maot shebbabbayit: 
Shene achin o shene shuttafin [av uveno] podin ze laze maaser sheni kede shello yosif chomesh. ishsha shehichnisa levalah maaser sheni hoil vehu mamon gavoah kemo shebbearnu lo kana baal. lefichach im padahu eno mosif chomesh: 
Happode maaser sheni leatzmo venatan et hakkeren velo natan et hachomesh. af al pi sheen hachomesh meakkev vahare nitchallel lo yochal ad sheyyitten hachomesh vaafillu beshabbat gezera shemma yifsha velo yitten: 
Maot maaser sheni im ratza letzarfam bedinre zahav kede lehakel massaan metzarfan. veim tzerfan leatzmo eno mosif chomesh sheen ze derech pediyya: 
Happoret sela mimmeot maaser sheni ben birushalayim ben chutz lirushalayim lo yetzarfenna kullah bemaot nechoshet ella beshekel maot kesef uveshekel maot nechoshet: 
Muttar lechallel kesef maaser im perot maaser al hakkesef vehu sheyyehu bapperot pachot mishsheve dinar. aval im haya bahen sheve dinar lo yechallelem im hakkesef ella bifne atzman. ketzad. hayu lo perot sheve dinar ushelosha dinarin shel maaser sheni eno mechallel hakkol al sela achat. aval im haya lo chatzi dinar perot vachatzi dinar maot mechallel shenehem al dinar echad:

Meot chullin umeot maaser shennitpazzeru velikket mikkan umikkan. ma shellikket likket lemaaser ad sheyyashlim. vehashshear chullin. veim balal vechafan o shellikket mitztzad echad umatza chaser hare ze lefi cheshbon. ketzad. hayu matayim maaser sheni umea chullin. nitpazzeru uvelalan vechafan hakkol nimtzeu matayim veshivim. hare mea ushemonim mehen maaser vetishim chullin. ze hakkelal hammitlakketin lemaaser sheni vehannivlalin lefi cheshbon. matne veomer im ellu shebbeyadi hen hammaaser hashshear chullin. veim hen chullin hare meot hammaaser bechol makom shehen mechullalin alehem: 
Sela shel maaser sheni veshel chulliyin shennitarvu mevi bassela maot vaafillu meot nechoshet veomer sela shel maaser sheni bechol makom shehi mechullelet al hammaot haellu. veachar kach borer et hayyafe shebbishtehen umechallel hammaot shel nechoshet aleha vetachazor hassela hayyafa lemaaser: 
Haomer livno maaser sheni bezavit zo venimtza bezavit acheret hare ellu chullin. amar lo hare sham mane venimtza matayim hashshear chullin. hare sham matayim venimtza mane hare hu chullin. hinniach mane maaser venimtza matayim. matayim venimtza mane. afillu hen bishne kisin hakkol chullin: 
Amar lo aviv kis maaser sheni li babbayit. halach umatza sham shelosha kisim. haggadol shebbechullan maaser vehashshear chullin. veaf al pi chen lo yochal min hakketannim ad sheyyechallelem al haggadol: 
Mi shennishtattek veamru lo maaser sheni shellecha bemakom peloni. vehirkin berosho. bodkin oto shalosh peamim kederech shebbodkin legittin vahare devarav kayyamin: 
Amru lo bachalom maaser sheni shel avicha sheatta mevakkesh hare hu bemakom peloni. af al pi shemmatza sham ma shenneemar lo eno maaser. divre chalomot lo maalin velo moridin: 
Haomer levanav afillu attem metim al tiggeu bezavit zo. venimtzeu sham maot hare ellu chullin. taman maot mippenehem veamar lahem shel peloni hen o shel maaser sheni hen. im kemaarim en choshshin lidvarav. veim kemitkavven devarav kayyamin: 
Hammotze keli vechatuv alav 40 hare ma shebbetocho maaser sheni. 4 demay. 9 tevel. 400 teruma. 100 karban. veim haya shel mattechet hu uma shebbetocho karban. shekken hayu kotvin ot achat min hashshem bishat hassakkana: 
Maot hannimtzaot birushalayim afillu dinre zahav im hakkesef veim hammaot hare ellu chullin. hoil veshuke yerushalayim mitkabbedin bechol yom. matza betochan cheres vechatuv bo maaser hare ellu maaser sheni. bamme devarim amurim bishar yemot hashshana. aval baregel hakkol maaser: 
Maot hannimtzaot lifne sochare behema birushalayim leolam maaser. shechezkat rov haam meviin meot maaser vekonin bo behemot. vehannimtzaot behar habbayit leolam chullin. shechezkatan mitterumat hallishka shechillelum haggizbarin al behema: 
Teva shennishtammesh bah chullin umaaser sheni. venimtza betochah maot. im rov mannichin maaser hare hammaot maaser. veim rov mannichin chullin chullin. mechetza lemechetza chullin: 
Matza perot ben perot maaser leferot teruma yippelu lakkarov. mechetza lemechetza yeachlu kechumre shenehen. asurin lezarim uteunin rechitzat yadayim vehaarev shemesh kitruma. vaasurim leonen uteunim havaat makom kemaaser. vechen hammaot hannimtzaot ben chullin lemaaser: 
Maaser sheni shel demay veshel vadday shennitarvu yeachlu kechamur shebbahen: 
Perot maaser shennitarvu beferot chullin yochal hakkol betohora bammakom o yifde et hammaaser. lefichach im nitarvu birushalayim asurin bechol shehen keminyan. hoil vehu birushalayim hare hu kedavar sheyyesh lo mattirin. veyeachel hakkol betohora: 
Hazzorea maaser sheni achar shennichnas lirushalayim haggiddulim maaser sheni. zerao kodem sheyyikkanes haggiddulin chullin. vaafillu bedavar sheen zaro kale. ufodin oto bishat zeriato: 
Maaser sheni batel berov. beeze maaser amru bemaaser shennichnas lirushalayim veyatza venaflu mechitztzot. shehare en sham mechitztzot lehachaziro lesham vei efshar lifdoto meachar shennichnas veaf al pi sheen bo sheve peruta venimtza davar sheen lo mattirin uvatel berov kemo shebbearnu behilchot issure maachalot:

Perot hannilkachot bechesef maaser sheni enan nifdin berichuk makom ella im ken nitmeu beav hattuma ella yaalu hen atzman veyeachlu birushalayim: 
Ze chomer belakuach bechesef maaser mipperot maaser atzman. veim nitma bivlad hattuma middivrehem yippadu veyeachlu birushalayim: 
En nilkach bechesef maaser ella maachal adam sheggiddulav min haaretz. o giddule giddulav min haaretz. kegon happerat hameforash battora <small>(Devarim 14 26)</small> "babbakar uvatztzon uvayyayin uvashshechar": 
Lefichach en lokchin bechesef maaser mayim umelach kemehin ufitriyyot lefi sheen giddulehem min haaretz. velo perot mechubbarin lakkarka. velo perot sheenan yecholim lehaggia lirushalayim. lefi sheenan domin levakar vatzon: 
Haddevash vehabbetzim vehechalav hare hen kevakar vatzon sheaf al pi sheenan giddule karka hare hen giddule gidduleha: 
Hattemed ad shello hechmitz eno nilkach bechesef maaser mippene shehu kemayim. umishshehechmitz nilkach kayyayin ucheshechar. lekacho ad shello hechmitz vehechemitz kana maaser: 
Bamme devarim amurim benatan shelosha mayim umatza pachot mearbaa. aval im natan shelosha vehotzi arbaa hare ze keyayin mazug venilkach bechesef maaser: 
Luleve zeradin vehecharuvin ad shello yamtiku en nilkachin. achar sheyyamtiku nilkachin. aval halluf vehachardal vehatturmusin ushear kol hannichbashim ben mishsheyyamtiku ben ad shello himtiku nilkachin. vehakkor nilkach bechesef maaser: 
Hakkarkom eno nilkach sheeno ella lemare. vechen kol kayyotze bo minnotne reach umare vetaam hoil veenan laachilat gufan ella letaam shennotnin enan nilkachin bechesef maaser. lefichach rashe besamim vehappilpelin vehakkosht vehachiltit vechallot charia vechol kayyotze baellu enan nilkachin bechesef maaser: 
Hashshevet im litten taam bikdera enah nilkachat bechesef maaser. veim lichmach vechayyotze bo shehu ochel gufah nilkachat bechesef maaser. erev mayim umelach im natan letocho shemen hare hen kemuryas velokeach mehen bechesef maaser. umavlia deme hammayim vehammelach bidme hashshemen: 
En lokchin terumot bechesef maaser mippene shehu memaet achilato vaachilatah. sheen ochlin otah ella kohanim meorve shemesh umutteret leonen veneechelet bechol makom. vehammaaser muttar lezarim velitvul yom veasur leonen veeno neechol ella birushalayim. nimtza memaet achilat maaser vaachilat hatteruma: 
Lokchin behema lezivche hashshelamim mikkesef hammaaser. shehashshelamim neechalim lezarim. barishona hayu lokchin behemot leachlan chullin mikkesef maaser sheni kede lehavericham meal hammizbeach. gazru bet din sheen lokchin behema mimmeot maaser ella lishlamim. aval chayya veof lokchin sheenan reuyin lishlamim: 
En lokchin perot sheviit bechesef maaser. lefi shehu chayyav levaer kemo sheyyitbaer: 
Hallokeach mayim umelach o perot mechubbarin o perot sheenan yecholin lehaggia lirushalayim lo kana hammaaser af al pi sheyyatzu hammaot lechullin: 
Hallokeach perot chutz lirushalayim bechesef maaser. beshogeg kofin et hammocher lehachazir haddamim labbealim vehen maaser kemot shehayu. bemezid yaalu happerot veyeachlu birushalayim. veim en mikdash yannichem ad sheyyerakvu: 
Vechen en lokchin behema bechesef maaser chutz lirushalayim. veim lakach beshogeg yachzeru haddamim limkoman. bemezid taale veteachel birushalayim. veim en mikdash tikkaver hi veorah: 
Lakach avadim vekarkaot uvehema temea ben bemezid ben beshogeg im barach hammocher hare ze yeachel keneged otan hammaot birushalayim betorat maaser. ze hakkelal kol shehotzi chutz laachila ushetiyya vesicha middeme maaser uvarach hammocher o met yeachel kenegdo. veim haya hammocher kayyam yachzeru haddamim limkoman. vechen im hevi olot vechattaot vaashamot middeme maaser yochal kenegdan: 
Lakach chayya lezivche shelamim. uvehema livsar taava. hare ze kemi shekkana shor lacharisha velo kana shelamim. lakach behema lishlamim venafal bah mum paka mimmenna kedushshat maaser ufode otah. veen haddamim maaser. veaf al pi chen im pedaah leatzmo mosif chomesh: 
Hammatpis meot maaser lishlamim lo kanu shelamim. shekkedushshat shelamim enah chala al kedushshat maaser. shehammaaser mamon gavoah hu. veen tzarich lomar im hitpis hammaaser atzman lishlamim shello kanu shelamim: 
Haochel maaser sheni betorat chullin afillu bemezid im perot hammaaser atzman achal yatza yede shamayim. veim kesef maaser achal yachzeru damim limkomam veyaalu veyeachlu birushalayim. o yochal kenegdan birushalayim im en yachol lehachazir et haddamim:
